image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画上古「尝百草」（神农氏）。时间传说时代。地点与格局：原始聚落、茅草屋、篝火、石器与陶器、莽莽山川与洪水。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、草，姜水两岸，荒草齐腰。人物：神农（炎帝神农氏）、女登（神农之母）、先民（姜水之民）、交易者（远方来客）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Tasting a Hundred Herbs: Shennong" in legendary antiquity, 2800 BCE. Place and layout: primitive settlements, thatched huts, bonfires, stone tools and pottery, vast wild mountains and rivers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, grass, Waist-high wild grass along both banks of the Jiang River. Figures: Shen Nong, Nü Deng, Xian Min, Jiao Yizhe. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是上古「尝百草」（神农氏），地点原始聚落、茅草屋、篝火、石器与陶器、莽莽山川与洪水，人物剪影：神农（炎帝神农氏）、女登（神农之母）、先民（姜水之民）、交易者（远方来客）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Tasting a Hundred Herbs: Shennong" in legendary antiquity, at primitive settlements, thatched huts, bonfires, stone tools and pottery, vast wild mountains and rivers. Silhouettes: Shen Nong, Nü Deng, Xian Min, Jiao Yizhe. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Thrice Past His Door: Yu Tames the Flood" in legendary antiquity, at primitive settlements, thatched huts, bonfires, stone tools and pottery, vast wild mountains and rivers. Silhouettes: Yu, Gun, Shun, Yi, Hou Ji, Tushan Shi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画商「盘庚迁殷」（殷人渡河）。时间约前 1300 年。地点与格局：夯土宫殿、青铜礼器、甲骨占卜、战车。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、城墙雉堞，河北旧都，城郭衰败。人物：盘庚（商王）、众臣（在位者）、殷民（众庶）、小辛（盘庚之弟）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Pangeng Moves to Yin" in the Shang, 1300 BCE. Place and layout: rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, crenellated city wall, The old capital north of the river, its walls decaying. Figures: Pan Geng, Zhong Chen, Yin Min, Xiao Xin. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

This cue: "Pangeng Moves to Yin" in the Shang, Pan Geng, Zhong Chen, Yin Min, Xiao Xin, rammed-earth palaces, bronze ritual vessels, oracle-bone divination, chariots. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画西周「宅兹中国」（营建成周）。时间约前 1038 年，成王五年。地点与格局：宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、云；中景：河水，洛水与伊水之间，晨雾未散。人物：周成王（周王）、周公旦（太宰）、召公奭（太保）、何（宗小子（何尊器主））。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Dwelling in the Centre: Building Chengzhou" in the Western Zhou, 1038 BCE. Place and layout: ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, clouds; midground: river, Morning mist between the Luo and Yi rivers. Figures: Zhou Chengwang, Zhou Gongdan, Shao Gong Shi, He. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是西周「宅兹中国」（营建成周），地点宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑，人物剪影：周成王（周王）、周公旦（太宰）、召公奭（太保）、何（宗小子（何尊器主））。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Dwelling in the Centre: Building Chengzhou" in the Western Zhou, at ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. Silhouettes: Zhou Chengwang, Zhou Gongdan, Shao Gong Shi, He. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "The King Who Never Returned: King Zhao" in the Western Zhou, 977 BCE. Place and layout: ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, trees, tree canopy, The broad Han River, Chu forests on the southern bank. Figures: Zhou Zhaowang, Ji Gong, Chu Zi, Guan Zhong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是西周「南征而不复」（周昭王），地点宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑，人物剪影：周昭王（周王）、祭公（周卿士）、楚子（楚国之君）、管仲（齐相）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "The King Who Never Returned: King Zhao" in the Western Zhou, at ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. Silhouettes: Zhou Zhaowang, Ji Gong, Chu Zi, Guan Zhong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是西周「八骏」（穆王西巡），地点宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑，人物剪影：周穆王（姬满）、造父（御者，赵之先祖）、祭公谋父（周卿士）、西王母（西方之君（神话化））、徐偃王（徐国之君）、犬戎（西方部族）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Eight Steeds: King Mu Rides West" in the Western Zhou, at ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. Silhouettes: Zhou Muwang, Zao Fu, Ji Gongmoufu, Xi Wangmu, Xu Yanwang, Quan Rong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Eight Steeds: King Mu Rides West" in the Western Zhou, Zhou Muwang, Zao Fu, Ji Gongmoufu, Xi Wangmu, Xu Yanwang, Quan Rong, ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画西周「烽火」（镐京之变）。时间前 771 年，周幽王十一年。地点与格局：宗庙与明堂、礼乐编钟、车马、分封城邑。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：近山与地面，骊山之上，烽燧一座。人物：周幽王（姬宫湦）、褒姒（幽王宠妃）、申侯（申国之君）、宜臼（太子，后之周平王）、虢石父（卿士）、犬戎（西戎）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Beacon Fires: the Fall of Hao" in the Western Zhou, 771 BCE. Place and layout: ancestral temples, ritual bells, chariots and horses, feudal walled towns. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: near hills and ground, A beacon tower on Mount Li. Figures: Zhou Youwang, Bao Si, Shen Hou, Yi Jiu, Guo Shifu, Quan Rong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画春秋「绵上之火」（介子推）。时间前 636 年，晋文公元年。地点与格局：诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：城墙雉堞、关门；主体：众人，绛都宫门外，从亡的功臣排队领赏，车马络绎。人物：介之推（从晋文公流亡十九年之臣）、晋文公（重耳，归国即位）、介母（介之推之母）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Fire on Mianshang: Jie Zitui" in the Spring and Autumn period, 636 BCE. Place and layout: feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. This shot's composition and action: midground: crenellated city wall, gate; subject: crowd, Outside the palace gate at Jiang, the companions of exile queue for rewards amid carts and horses. Figures: Jie Zhitui, Jin Wengong, Jie Mu. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画春秋「紫气东来」（老子出关）。时间约春秋末年，东周敬王时（约数）。地点与格局：诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：老子，洛邑的藏书之室，竹简一直堆到屋梁。人物：老子（周守藏室之史，李耳）、尹喜（关令（《列仙传》作关令尹））、孔子（鲁人孔丘）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Purple Air from the East: Laozi Leaves Through the Pass" in the Spring and Autumn period, 500 BCE. Place and layout: feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.  Figures: Lao Zi, Yin Xi, Kong Zi. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是春秋「紫气东来」（老子出关），地点诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭，人物剪影：老子（周守藏室之史，李耳）、尹喜（关令（《列仙传》作关令尹））、孔子（鲁人孔丘）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Purple Air from the East: Laozi Leaves Through the Pass" in the Spring and Autumn period, at feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. Silhouettes: Lao Zi, Yin Xi, Kong Zi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐开阔：长音如风沿着地图上的河走远，低而慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要紧促的战鼓。本场：春秋「紫气东来」（老子出关），老子（周守藏室之史，李耳）、尹喜（关令（《列仙传》作关令尹））、孔子（鲁人孔丘），诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Purple Air from the East: Laozi Leaves Through the Pass" in the Spring and Autumn period, Lao Zi, Yin Xi, Kong Zi, feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是春秋「卧薪尝胆」（吴越争霸），地点诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭，人物剪影：勾践（越王）、夫差（吴王）、范蠡（越大夫）、文种（越大夫）、伍子胥（吴大夫）、西施（越女）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Sleeping on Brushwood, Tasting Gall: Wu and Yue" in the Spring and Autumn period, at feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities. Silhouettes: Gou Jian, Fu Cha, Fan Li, Wen Zhong, Wu Zixu, Xi Shi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画战国「怀沙」（屈原）。时间约前 278 年，楚顷襄王二十一年前后。地点与格局：列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：城墙雉堞、关门；主体：屈原，郢都宫门关上，一个高冠长剑的人被逐出城。人物：屈原（楚国三闾大夫屈平）、渔父（江边的渔人）、楚顷襄王（楚君）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Embracing the Sand: Qu Yuan" in the Warring States, 278 BCE. Place and layout: capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. This shot's composition and action: midground: crenellated city wall, gate; subject: Qu Yuan, The gate of Ying closes behind a man in a tall hat with a long sword, driven out of the city. Figures: Qu Yuan, Yu Fu, Chu Qingxiangwang. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画战国「都江堰」（李冰治水）。时间约前 256—前 251 年，秦昭王末年。地点与格局：列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：河水、洪水、近山与地面，岷江出山口，江水夹着泥沙奔腾而下，下游田地一半淹在水里。人物：李冰（秦蜀郡守）、李冰之子（传说）（后世称二郎）、蜀地民夫（治水的民夫）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Dujiangyan: Li Bing Tames the River" in the Warring States, 256 BCE. Place and layout: capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. This shot's composition and action: midground: river, flood waters, near hills and ground, Where the Min leaves the mountains, the river rushes down thick with silt and half the farmland below lies flooded. Figures: Li Bing, Li Bingzhizi, Shu Diminfu. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是战国「都江堰」（李冰治水），地点列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简，人物剪影：李冰（秦蜀郡守）、李冰之子（传说）（后世称二郎）、蜀地民夫（治水的民夫）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Dujiangyan: Li Bing Tames the River" in the Warring States, at capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. Silhouettes: Li Bing, Li Bingzhizi, Shu Diminfu. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Dujiangyan: Li Bing Tames the River" in the Warring States, Li Bing, Li Bingzhizi, Shu Diminfu, capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是秦「徐福东渡」（入海求仙），地点咸阳宫阙、驰道、长城、刻石、竹简与小篆，人物剪影：徐福（徐市，齐方士）、秦始皇（嬴政）、卢生（燕方士）、伍被（淮南王门客）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Xu Fu Sails East in Search of Immortals" in the Qin, at Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script. Silhouettes: Xu Fu, Qin Shi Huang, Lu Sheng, Wu Bei. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

Place and layout: Xianyang palaces, imperial roads, the Great Wall, stone inscriptions, bamboo slips in small-seal script. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「白登之围」（平城七日）。时间前 200 年，汉高祖七年。地点与格局：未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；主体：军阵、长兵如林；题字「雪」后期叠加，画面只留飞白笔势，冬天大寒雨雪，士卒堕指者十之二三。人物：汉高祖（刘邦）、冒顿单于（匈奴单于）、陈平（护军中尉）、刘敬（娄敬）、阏氏（单于之妻）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "The Siege of Baideng: Seven Days at Pingcheng" in the Western Han, 200 BCE. Place and layout: Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.  Figures: Han Gaozu, Modu Chanyu, Chen Ping, Liu Jing, Yanzhi. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「缇萦上书」（废肉刑）。时间前 167 年，汉文帝前元十三年。地点与格局：未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：城墙雉堞、关门；主体：淳于意、众人，临淄城外，囚车启程，一个男人回头骂身后哭泣的五个女儿。人物：缇萦（淳于意少女）、淳于意（齐太仓令，名医，世称仓公）、汉文帝（刘恒）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Tiying's Petition: Ending Mutilating Punishments" in the Western Han, 167 BCE. Place and layout: Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans. This shot's composition and action: midground: crenellated city wall, gate; subject: Chun Yuyi, crowd, Outside Linzi the prison cart sets off, and a man turns to curse his five weeping daughters. Figures: Ti Ying, Chun Yuyi, Han Wendi. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是楚汉 · 西汉「缇萦上书」（废肉刑），地点未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队，人物剪影：缇萦（淳于意少女）、淳于意（齐太仓令，名医，世称仓公）、汉文帝（刘恒）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Tiying's Petition: Ending Mutilating Punishments" in the Western Han, at Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans. Silhouettes: Ti Ying, Chun Yuyi, Han Wendi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐开阔：长音如风沿着地图上的河走远，低而慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要紧促的战鼓。本场：楚汉 · 西汉「缇萦上书」（废肉刑），缇萦（淳于意少女）、淳于意（齐太仓令，名医，世称仓公）、汉文帝（刘恒），未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Tiying's Petition: Ending Mutilating Punishments" in the Western Han, Ti Ying, Chun Yuyi, Han Wendi, Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是楚汉 · 西汉「凿空」（张骞出使西域），地点未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队，人物剪影：张骞（郎，后封博望侯）、堂邑父（甘父，胡人）、汉武帝（刘彻）、匈奴单于（军臣单于）、胡妻（张骞在匈奴所娶）、大月氏王（月氏之君）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Opening the West: Zhang Qian's Mission" in the Western Han, at Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans. Silhouettes: Zhang Qian, Tang Yifu, Han Wudi, Xiong Nu Chanyu, Hu Qi, Da Yueshiwang. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「明犯强汉者」（陈汤）。时间前 36 年，汉元帝建昭三年。地点与格局：未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、城墙雉堞，康居之地，都赖水上的土城。人物：陈汤（西域副校尉）、甘延寿（西域都护）、郅支单于（匈奴单于）、汉元帝（刘奭）、匡衡（丞相）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「昭君出塞」（宁胡阏氏）。时间前 33 年，汉元帝竟宁元年。地点与格局：未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、云；中景：殿柱、屋檐，长安宫阙，掖庭深处。人物：王昭君（王嫱）、呼韩邪单于（匈奴单于）、汉元帝（刘奭）、毛延寿（画工）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Zhaojun Beyond the Frontier" in the Western Han, 33 BCE. Place and layout: Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, clouds; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, Deep within the palace of Chang'an. Figures: Wang Zhaojun, Huhanye Chanyu, Han Yuandi, Mao Yanshou. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画新 · 东汉「白马驮经」（永平求法）。时间约 67 年，东汉明帝永平十年。地点与格局：洛阳宫殿、太学、坞堡、西域城郭。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：月；中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：汉明帝，南宫夜深，皇帝梦见一个金色的人，头顶有光，在殿前飞行。人物：汉明帝（刘庄）、蔡愔（郎中，求法使者）、摄摩腾（天竺沙门（迦叶摩腾））、竺法兰（天竺沙门）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "The White Horse Carries the Sutras: Seeking the Dharma" in the Eastern Han, 67 CE. Place and layout: Luoyang palaces, the Imperial Academy, fortified manors, Western Regions oasis towns. This shot's composition and action: background: moon; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Han Mingdi, Deep in the Southern Palace the emperor dreams of a golden man with a halo, flying before the hall. Figures: Han Mingdi, Cai Yin, She Moteng, Zhu Falan. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是新 · 东汉「白马驮经」（永平求法），地点洛阳宫殿、太学、坞堡、西域城郭，人物剪影：汉明帝（刘庄）、蔡愔（郎中，求法使者）、摄摩腾（天竺沙门（迦叶摩腾））、竺法兰（天竺沙门）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "The White Horse Carries the Sutras: Seeking the Dharma" in the Eastern Han, at Luoyang palaces, the Imperial Academy, fortified manors, Western Regions oasis towns. Silhouettes: Han Mingdi, Cai Yin, She Moteng, Zhu Falan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "The White Horse Carries the Sutras: Seeking the Dharma" in the Eastern Han, Han Mingdi, Cai Yin, She Moteng, Zhu Falan, Luoyang palaces, the Imperial Academy, fortified manors, Western Regions oasis towns. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是新 · 东汉「造纸与地动仪」（蔡伦与张衡），地点洛阳宫殿、太学、坞堡、西域城郭，人物剪影：蔡伦（中常侍，尚方令）、张衡（太史令）、邓太后（和熹皇后）、汉顺帝（刘保）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Paper and the Seismoscope: Cai Lun and Zhang Heng" in the Eastern Han, at Luoyang palaces, the Imperial Academy, fortified manors, Western Regions oasis towns. Silhouettes: Cai Lun, Zhang Heng, Empress Dowager Deng, Han Shundi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画三国「曹冲称象」（仓舒早慧）。时间约 205 年前后，东汉建安中。地点与格局：城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：众人，江东送来的巨象站在庭院里，比屋檐还高。人物：曹冲（字仓舒，曹操之子）、曹操（司空）、曹丕（曹操之子）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Cao Chong Weighs the Elephant: A Precocious Child" in the Three Kingdoms, 205 CE. Place and layout: walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. This shot's composition and action: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: crowd, The great elephant sent from the east stands in the courtyard, taller than the eaves. Figures: Cao Chong, Cao Cao, Cao Pi. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画三国「赤壁之战」（火烧战船）。时间208 年，建安十三年。地点与格局：城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：河水，大江东去，赤壁临江。人物：周瑜（左都督）、黄盖（吴将）、曹操（丞相）、诸葛亮（刘备军师）、孙权（讨虏将军）、鲁肃（孙权谋士）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "The Battle of Red Cliffs: Fire on the Fleet" in the Three Kingdoms, 208 CE. Place and layout: walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: river, The great river flows east past the Red Cliffs. Figures: Zhou Yu, Huang Gai, Cao Cao, Zhuge Liang, Sun Quan, Lu Su. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画三国「威震逍遥津」（八百破十万）。时间215 年八月，建安二十年。地点与格局：城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。这一镜的构图与动作：主体：张辽、李典、盾墙，合肥城头，一个木匣打开，里面是曹操的手令：若孙权至者，张、李将军出战。人物：张辽（荡寇将军）、孙权（讨虏将军，领会稽太守）、李典（破虏将军）、凌统（偏将军）、谷利（孙权亲近监）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Terror at Xiaoyao Ford: Eight Hundred Against a Hundred Thousand" in the Three Kingdoms, 215 CE. Place and layout: walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. This shot's composition and action: subject: Zhang Liao, Li Dian, shield wall, On the walls of Hefei a wooden box is opened: Cao Cao's order says if Sun Quan comes, Zhang and Li go out to fight. Figures: Zhang Liao, Sun Quan, Li Dian, Ling Tong, Gu Li. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是三国「威震逍遥津」（八百破十万），地点城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河，人物剪影：张辽（荡寇将军）、孙权（讨虏将军，领会稽太守）、李典（破虏将军）、凌统（偏将军）、谷利（孙权亲近监）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Terror at Xiaoyao Ford: Eight Hundred Against a Hundred Thousand" in the Three Kingdoms, at walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. Silhouettes: Zhang Liao, Sun Quan, Li Dian, Ling Tong, Gu Li. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是三国「水淹七军」（走麦城），地点城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河，人物剪影：关羽（前将军）、于禁（左将军）、庞德（立义将军）、曹仁（征南将军）、吕蒙（汉昌太守）、糜芳（南郡太守）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Flooding the Seven Armies, Retreat to Maicheng" in the Three Kingdoms, at walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. Silhouettes: Guan Yu, Yu Jin, Pang De, Cao Ren, Lü Meng, Mi Fang. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Flooding the Seven Armies, Retreat to Maicheng" in the Three Kingdoms, Guan Yu, Yu Jin, Pang De, Cao Ren, Lü Meng, Mi Fang, walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画三国「火烧连营」（夷陵之战）。时间222 年，蜀章武二年，吴黄武元年。地点与格局：城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：树、树冠，三峡山道，蜀军连营数百里。人物：陆逊（大都督）、刘备（蜀汉皇帝）、孙权（吴王）、黄权（镇北将军）、冯习（蜀将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Burning the Linked Camps: the Battle of Yiling" in the Three Kingdoms, 222 CE. Place and layout: walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: trees, tree canopy, Shu camps stretch hundreds of li along the Three Gorges roads. Figures: Lu Xun, Liu Bei, Sun Quan, Huang Quan, Feng Xi. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画三国「街亭与空城」（马谡）。时间228 年，蜀汉建兴六年。地点与格局：城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、河水，陇右群山，街亭要道。人物：马谡（参军）、诸葛亮（丞相）、王平（裨将军）、张郃（左将军）、司马懿（骠骑将军）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Jieting and the Empty City: Ma Su" in the Three Kingdoms, 228 CE. Place and layout: walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, river, Mountains of Longyou and the vital road at Jieting. Figures: Ma Su, Zhuge Liang, Wang Ping, Zhang He, Sima Yi. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是三国「街亭与空城」（马谡），地点城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河，人物剪影：马谡（参军）、诸葛亮（丞相）、王平（裨将军）、张郃（左将军）、司马懿（骠骑将军）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Jieting and the Empty City: Ma Su" in the Three Kingdoms, at walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. Silhouettes: Ma Su, Zhuge Liang, Wang Ping, Zhang He, Sima Yi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画三国「秋风五丈原」（星落）。时间234 年，蜀汉建兴十二年。地点与格局：城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、近山与地面，渭水之南，五丈原。人物：诸葛亮（丞相）、司马懿（大都督）、杨仪（长史）、姜维（征西将军）、魏延（征西大将军）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Autumn Wind at Wuzhang Plains: the Falling Star" in the Three Kingdoms, 234 CE. Place and layout: walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, near hills and ground, Wuzhang Plains south of the Wei River. Figures: Zhuge Liang, Sima Yi, Yang Yi, Jiang Wei, Wei Yan. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是三国「秋风五丈原」（星落），地点城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河，人物剪影：诸葛亮（丞相）、司马懿（大都督）、杨仪（长史）、姜维（征西将军）、魏延（征西大将军）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Autumn Wind at Wuzhang Plains: the Falling Star" in the Three Kingdoms, at walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. Silhouettes: Zhuge Liang, Sima Yi, Yang Yi, Jiang Wei, Wei Yan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Autumn Wind at Wuzhang Plains: the Falling Star" in the Three Kingdoms, Zhuge Liang, Sima Yi, Yang Yi, Jiang Wei, Wei Yan, walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是三国「偷渡阴平」（邓艾入蜀），地点城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河，人物剪影：邓艾（征西将军）、钟会（镇西将军）、姜维（大将军）、诸葛瞻（卫将军，诸葛亮之子）、刘禅（蜀汉后主）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Crossing Yinping in Secret: Deng Ai Enters Shu" in the Three Kingdoms, at walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. Silhouettes: Deng Ai, Zhong Hui, Jiang Wei, Zhuge Zhan, Liu Chan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Crossing Yinping in Secret: Deng Ai Enters Shu" in the Three Kingdoms, Deng Ai, Zhong Hui, Jiang Wei, Zhuge Zhan, Liu Chan, walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画两晋「中流击楫」（祖逖北伐）。时间313—321 年，晋建兴元年至太兴四年。地点与格局：江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、烟，大江之上，北岸烽烟。人物：祖逖（士稚）、刘琨（越石）、司马睿（琅邪王）、石勒（后赵主）、戴渊（征西将军）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Striking the Oar Midstream: Zu Ti's Northern Campaign" in the Jin, 313 CE. Place and layout: Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, smoke, Beacon smoke on the north bank of the river. Figures: Zu Ti, Liu Kun, Sima Rui, Shi Lei, Dai Yuan. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画两晋「风声鹤唳」（淝水之战）。时间383 年，东晋太元八年。地点与格局：江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：河水，寿阳城外，八公山，淝水。人物：谢安（东晋宰相）、谢玄（前锋都督）、谢石（征讨大都督）、刘牢之（北府兵将领）、苻坚（前秦皇帝）、苻融（苻坚之弟）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Every Rustle an Enemy: the Battle of the Fei River" in the Jin, 383 CE. Place and layout: Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: river, Outside Shouyang: Mount Bagong and the Fei River. Figures: Xie An, Xie Xuan, Xie Shi, Liu Laozhi, Fu Jian, Fu Rong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是两晋「风声鹤唳」（淝水之战），地点江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城，人物剪影：谢安（东晋宰相）、谢玄（前锋都督）、谢石（征讨大都督）、刘牢之（北府兵将领）、苻坚（前秦皇帝）、苻融（苻坚之弟）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Every Rustle an Enemy: the Battle of the Fei River" in the Jin, at Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city. Silhouettes: Xie An, Xie Xuan, Xie Shi, Liu Laozhi, Fu Jian, Fu Rong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画两晋「归去来」（陶渊明）。时间405 年十一月，东晋义熙元年十一月。地点与格局：江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞、树、树冠，彭泽县衙，秋日。人物：陶渊明（陶潜，元亮）、督邮（郡吏）、武陵渔人（《桃花源记》中的人物）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Home Again: Tao Yuanming" in the Jin, 405 CE. Place and layout: Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, trees, tree canopy, Autumn at the Pengze county office. Figures: Tao Yuanming, Du You, Wu Lingyuren. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是两晋「归去来」（陶渊明），地点江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城，人物剪影：陶渊明（陶潜，元亮）、督邮（郡吏）、武陵渔人（《桃花源记》中的人物）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Home Again: Tao Yuanming" in the Jin, at Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city. Silhouettes: Tao Yuanming, Du You, Wu Lingyuren. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是两晋「气吞万里」（刘裕北伐），地点江南园林、曲水、竹林、建康城，人物剪影：刘裕（太尉，后之宋武帝）、王镇恶（前锋）、姚泓（后秦皇帝）、檀道济（将领）、北魏军（北魏骑兵）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Swallowing Ten Thousand Li: Liu Yu's Northern Campaign" in the Jin, at Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city. Silhouettes: Liu Yu, Wang Zhene, Yao Hong, Tan Daoji, Bei Weijun. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Swallowing Ten Thousand Li: Liu Yu's Northern Campaign" in the Jin, Liu Yu, Wang Zhene, Yao Hong, Tan Daoji, Bei Weijun, Jiangnan gardens, winding streams, bamboo groves, Jiankang city. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南北朝「木兰辞」（替父从军）。时间北朝（无确年）。地点与格局：佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：树、树冠、关门；主体：木兰，唧唧复唧唧，木兰当户织。人物：木兰（诗中女子）、木兰之父（老军户）、天子（可汗）、火伴（同行军士）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "The Ballad of Mulan" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, 450 CE. Place and layout: Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts. This shot's composition and action: midground: trees, tree canopy, gate; subject: Mu Lan, Click-clack, Mulan weaves at the door. Figures: Mu Lan, Mu Lanzhifu, Tian Zi, Huo Ban. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "The Ballad of Mulan" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, Mu Lan, Mu Lanzhifu, Tian Zi, Huo Ban, Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南北朝「迁都洛阳」（北魏孝文帝）。时间493—496 年，北魏太和十七年至二十年。地点与格局：佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：沙、城墙雉堞，平城，北地风沙。人物：北魏孝文帝（拓跋宏（元宏））、李冲（尚书）、拓跋恂（太子）、鲜卑旧臣（代北贵族）、冯太后（文明太后）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Moving the Capital to Luoyang: Emperor Xiaowen of Wei" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, 493 CE. Place and layout: Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: sand, crenellated city wall, Wind and sand of the north at Pingcheng. Figures: Bei Weixiaowendi, Li Chong, Tuoba Xun, Xian Beijiuchen, Empress Dowager Feng. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.
