video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是南北朝「迁都洛阳」（北魏孝文帝），地点佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞，人物剪影：北魏孝文帝（拓跋宏（元宏））、李冲（尚书）、拓跋恂（太子）、鲜卑旧臣（代北贵族）、冯太后（文明太后）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Moving the Capital to Luoyang: Emperor Xiaowen of Wei" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, at Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts. Silhouettes: Bei Weixiaowendi, Li Chong, Tuoba Xun, Xian Beijiuchen, Empress Dowager Feng. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南北朝「水经注」（郦道元之死）。时间527 年，北魏孝明帝孝昌三年。地点与格局：佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水；主体：郦道元、战马，黄河边，一个官员骑着马沿河而上，随从背着一捆捆竹简和地图。人物：郦道元（御史中尉，后为关右大使）、萧宝夤（雍州刺史，南齐宗室）、元悦（汝南王）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Commentary on the Waterways: The Death of Li Daoyuan" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, 527 CE. Place and layout: Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river; subject: Li Daoyuan, war horse, By the Yellow River an official rides upstream, his attendants carrying bundles of bamboo slips and maps. Figures: Li Daoyuan, Xiao Baoyin, Yuan Yue. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是南北朝「水经注」（郦道元之死），地点佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞，人物剪影：郦道元（御史中尉，后为关右大使）、萧宝夤（雍州刺史，南齐宗室）、元悦（汝南王）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Commentary on the Waterways: The Death of Li Daoyuan" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, at Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts. Silhouettes: Li Daoyuan, Xiao Baoyin, Yuan Yue. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是南北朝「河阴之变」（尔朱荣），地点佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞，人物剪影：尔朱荣（契胡酋长，大都督）、胡太后（灵太后）、元子攸（北魏孝庄帝）、元钊（三岁幼主）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "The Heyin Massacre: Erzhu Rong" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, at Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts. Silhouettes: Er Zhurong, Empress Dowager Hu, Yuan Ziyou, Yuan Zhao. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "The Heyin Massacre: Erzhu Rong" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, Er Zhurong, Empress Dowager Hu, Yuan Ziyou, Yuan Zhao, Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南北朝「玉壁之战」（韦孝宽）。时间546 年，西魏大统十二年、东魏武定四年。地点与格局：佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、城墙雉堞，汾水之北，玉壁孤城。人物：韦孝宽（西魏玉壁守将）、高欢（东魏丞相）、斛律金（东魏大将）、祖珽（东魏参军）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "The Battle of Yubi: Wei Xiaokuan" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, 546 CE. Place and layout: Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, crenellated city wall, The lone fortress of Yubi north of the Fen River. Figures: Wei Xiaokuan, Gao Huan, Hulü Jin, Zu Ting. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南北朝「台城」（侯景之乱）。时间548—552 年，梁太清二年至承圣元年。地点与格局：佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、城墙雉堞，建康，台城与长江。人物：侯景（河南王）、梁武帝（萧衍）、萧正德（临贺王）、羊侃（都官尚书）、王僧辩（梁将）、陈霸先（梁将，后之陈武帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Taicheng: the Hou Jing Rebellion" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, 548 CE. Place and layout: Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, crenellated city wall, Jiankang, Taicheng and the Yangtze. Figures: Hou Jing, Liang Wudi, Xiao Zhengde, Yang Kan, Wang Sengbian, Chen Baxian. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Taicheng: the Hou Jing Rebellion" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, at Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts. Silhouettes: Hou Jing, Liang Wudi, Xiao Zhengde, Yang Kan, Wang Sengbian, Chen Baxian. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画隋「渡江」（隋灭陈）。时间589 年，隋开皇九年。地点与格局：大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、近山与地面，大江南北，两岸相望。人物：隋文帝（杨坚）、杨广（晋王，伐陈元帅）、韩擒虎（庐州总管）、贺若弼（吴州总管）、陈叔宝（陈后主）、张丽华（贵妃）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Crossing the River: Sui Conquers Chen" in the Sui, 589 CE. Place and layout: Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, near hills and ground, The two banks of the Yangtze face each other. Figures: Sui Wendi, Yang Guang, Han Qinhu, He Ruobi, Chen Shubao, Zhang Lihua. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是隋「渡江」（隋灭陈），地点大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱，人物剪影：隋文帝（杨坚）、杨广（晋王，伐陈元帅）、韩擒虎（庐州总管）、贺若弼（吴州总管）、陈叔宝（陈后主）、张丽华（贵妃）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Crossing the River: Sui Conquers Chen" in the Sui, at Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. Silhouettes: Sui Wendi, Yang Guang, Han Qinhu, He Ruobi, Chen Shubao, Zhang Lihua. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是隋「大石桥」（李春），地点大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱，人物剪影：李春（隋代工匠）、张嘉贞（唐代宰相）、石匠（赵郡工匠）、鲁班（传说中的巨匠）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "The Great Stone Bridge: Li Chun" in the Sui, at Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. Silhouettes: Li Chun, Zhang Jiazhen, Shi Jiang, Lu Ban. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐开阔：长音如风沿着地图上的河走远，低而慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要紧促的战鼓。本场：隋「大石桥」（李春），李春（隋代工匠）、张嘉贞（唐代宰相）、石匠（赵郡工匠）、鲁班（传说中的巨匠），大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "The Great Stone Bridge: Li Chun" in the Sui, Li Chun, Zhang Jiazhen, Shi Jiang, Lu Ban, Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画隋「大运河」（通济与永济）。时间605—610 年，隋大业元年至六年。地点与格局：大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、草，中原平野，黄河与淮水之间。人物：隋炀帝（杨广）、宇文恺（将作大匠）、麻叔谋（开河都护）、河工（河南诸郡男女）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "The Grand Canal: Tongji and Yongji" in the Sui, 605 CE. Place and layout: Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, grass, Central plains between the Yellow River and the Huai. Figures: Sui Yangdi, Yuwen Kai, Ma Shumou, He Gong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "The Grand Canal: Tongji and Yongji" in the Sui, Sui Yangdi, Yuwen Kai, Ma Shumou, He Gong, Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画隋「雁门之围」（疑兵）。时间615 年八至九月，隋大业十一年。地点与格局：大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面；主体：骑兵，雁门关外，突厥骑兵漫山遍野。人物：杨广（隋炀帝）、始毕可汗（东突厥可汗）、义成公主（隋宗室女，嫁突厥）、李世民（应募少年）、云定兴（屯卫将军）、萧瑀（内史侍郎）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "The Siege of Yanmen: Phantom Army" in the Sui, 615 CE. Place and layout: Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: cavalry, Turkic horsemen cover the hills beyond Yanmen Pass. Figures: Yang Guang, Shibi Qaghan, Princess Yicheng, Li Shimin, Yun Dingxing, Xiao Yu. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是隋「雁门之围」（疑兵），地点大兴城、运河龙舟、宫殿斗拱，人物剪影：杨广（隋炀帝）、始毕可汗（东突厥可汗）、义成公主（隋宗室女，嫁突厥）、李世民（应募少年）、云定兴（屯卫将军）、萧瑀（内史侍郎）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "The Siege of Yanmen: Phantom Army" in the Sui, at Daxing city, the Grand Canal and dragon boats, bracketed palace halls. Silhouettes: Yang Guang, Shibi Qaghan, Princess Yicheng, Li Shimin, Yun Dingxing, Xiao Yu. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画唐「西行」（玄奘取经）。时间约 629—645 年，唐贞观三年至十九年。地点与格局：长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：沙、关门，玉门关外，五座烽燧。人物：玄奘（陈祎，三藏法师）、石槃陀（胡人弟子）、麴文泰（高昌王）、戒贤（那烂陀寺住持）、戒日王（天竺之王）、唐太宗（李世民）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Journey West: Xuanzang's Pilgrimage" in the Tang, 629 CE. Place and layout: Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: sand, gate, Five beacon towers beyond Yumen Pass. Figures: Xuan Zang, Shi Pantuo, Qu Wentai, Jie Xian, Jie Riwang, Tang Taizong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是唐「西行」（玄奘取经），地点长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧，人物剪影：玄奘（陈祎，三藏法师）、石槃陀（胡人弟子）、麴文泰（高昌王）、戒贤（那烂陀寺住持）、戒日王（天竺之王）、唐太宗（李世民）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Journey West: Xuanzang's Pilgrimage" in the Tang, at Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. Silhouettes: Xuan Zang, Shi Pantuo, Qu Wentai, Jie Xian, Jie Riwang, Tang Taizong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是唐「文成公主入藏」（唐蕃和亲），地点长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧，人物剪影：文成公主（宗室女）、松赞干布（弃宗弄赞，吐蕃赞普）、禄东赞（吐蕃大论）、李道宗（江夏王）、唐太宗（李世民）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Princess Wencheng Goes to Tibet" in the Tang, at Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. Silhouettes: Princess Wencheng, Songtsen Gampo, Gar Tongtsen, Li Daozong, Tang Taizong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐开阔：长音如风沿着地图上的河走远，低而慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要紧促的战鼓。本场：唐「文成公主入藏」（唐蕃和亲），文成公主（宗室女）、松赞干布（弃宗弄赞，吐蕃赞普）、禄东赞（吐蕃大论）、李道宗（江夏王）、唐太宗（李世民），长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Princess Wencheng Goes to Tibet" in the Tang, Princess Wencheng, Songtsen Gampo, Gar Tongtsen, Li Daozong, Tang Taizong, Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画唐「六渡扶桑」（鉴真东渡）。时间753 年十二月，唐玄宗天宝十二载。地点与格局：长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：荣睿、普照、鉴真、众人，扬州大明寺，两个日本僧人跪在一位老和尚面前。人物：鉴真（扬州大明寺律师）、荣睿（日本留学僧）、普照（日本留学僧）、思托（鉴真弟子）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Six Crossings to Japan: Jianzhen Sails East" in the Tang, 753 CE. Place and layout: Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. This shot's composition and action: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Rong Rui, Pu Zhao, Jian Zhen, crowd, At the Daming Temple in Yangzhou two Japanese monks kneel before an old master. Figures: Jian Zhen, Rong Rui, Pu Zhao, Si Tuo. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画唐「睢阳」（张巡与许远）。时间756—757 年，唐天宝十五载至至德二载。地点与格局：长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞；主体：盾墙，睢阳城，江淮门户。人物：张巡（河南节度副使）、许远（睢阳太守）、南霁云（张巡部将）、雷万春（张巡部将）、尹子琦（安庆绪部将）、贺兰进明（河南节度使）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Suiyang: Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan" in the Tang, 756 CE. Place and layout: Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall; subject: shield wall, Suiyang, gateway to the Yangtze–Huai region. Figures: Zhang Xun, Xu Yuan, Nan Jiyun, Lei Wanchun, Yin Ziqi, He Lanjinming. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是唐「睢阳」（张巡与许远），地点长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧，人物剪影：张巡（河南节度副使）、许远（睢阳太守）、南霁云（张巡部将）、雷万春（张巡部将）、尹子琦（安庆绪部将）、贺兰进明（河南节度使）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Suiyang: Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan" in the Tang, at Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. Silhouettes: Zhang Xun, Xu Yuan, Nan Jiyun, Lei Wanchun, Yin Ziqi, He Lanjinming. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画唐「会昌毁佛」（圆仁亲见）。时间845 年八月，唐武宗会昌五年。地点与格局：长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：月；中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：圆仁，长安资圣寺，一个日本僧人在灯下记下这一天的诏令。人物：唐武宗（李炎）、赵归真（道士）、圆仁（日本入唐求法僧）、李德裕（宰相）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "The Huichang Suppression: Ennin's Eyewitness" in the Tang, 845 CE. Place and layout: Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers.  Figures: Tang Wuzong, Zhao Guizhen, Yuan Ren, Li Deyu. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是唐「会昌毁佛」（圆仁亲见），地点长安坊市、大明宫、驼队、边塞烽燧，人物剪影：唐武宗（李炎）、赵归真（道士）、圆仁（日本入唐求法僧）、李德裕（宰相）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "The Huichang Suppression: Ennin's Eyewitness" in the Tang, at Chang'an wards and markets, Daming Palace, camel caravans, frontier beacon towers. Silhouettes: Tang Wuzong, Zhao Guizhen, Yuan Ren, Li Deyu. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是五代十国「捍海塘」（钱镠），地点汴梁与金陵、江南园林、军镇，人物剪影：钱镠（吴越王）、吴氏（钱镠之妻）、筑塘役夫（钱塘工匠）、潮神（传说中的涛神）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "The Sea Wall: Qian Liu" in the Five Dynasties, at Bianliang and Jinling, Jiangnan gardens, military garrisons. Silhouettes: Qian Liu, Wu Shi, Zhu Tangyifu, Chao Shen. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐开阔：长音如风沿着地图上的河走远，低而慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要紧促的战鼓。本场：五代十国「捍海塘」（钱镠），钱镠（吴越王）、吴氏（钱镠之妻）、筑塘役夫（钱塘工匠）、潮神（传说中的涛神），汴梁与金陵、江南园林、军镇。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "The Sea Wall: Qian Liu" in the Five Dynasties, Qian Liu, Wu Shi, Zhu Tangyifu, Chao Shen, Bianliang and Jinling, Jiangnan gardens, military garrisons. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画北宋「澶渊之盟」（景德元年）。时间1004—1005 年，宋景德元年至二年。地点与格局：汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水、城墙雉堞，黄河两岸，澶州南北二城。人物：宋真宗（赵恒）、寇准（宰相）、萧太后（萧绰，承天太后）、辽圣宗（耶律隆绪）、萧挞凛（辽统军）、曹利用（使臣）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "The Treaty of Chanyuan" in the Northern Song, 1004 CE. Place and layout: Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river, crenellated city wall, The two towns of Chanzhou on either bank of the Yellow River. Figures: Song Zhenzong, Kou Zhun, Empress Dowager Xiao, Liao Shengzong, Xiao Talin, Cao Liyong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "The Treaty of Chanyuan" in the Northern Song, Song Zhenzong, Kou Zhun, Empress Dowager Xiao, Liao Shengzong, Xiao Talin, Cao Liyong, Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画北宋「胶泥活字」（毕昇）。时间约 1041—1048 年，宋仁宗庆历年间。地点与格局：汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：众人，印书铺里，一块块雕好的木板堆到了屋顶，每块只能印一页。人物：毕昇（布衣，刻印工匠）、沈括（学者，《梦溪笔谈》作者）、印工（毕昇作坊里的匠人）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Clay Movable Type: Bi Sheng" in the Northern Song, 1045 CE. Place and layout: Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls.  Figures: Bi Sheng, Shen Kuo, Yin Gong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是北宋「胶泥活字」（毕昇），地点汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿，人物剪影：毕昇（布衣，刻印工匠）、沈括（学者，《梦溪笔谈》作者）、印工（毕昇作坊里的匠人）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Clay Movable Type: Bi Sheng" in the Northern Song, at Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. Silhouettes: Bi Sheng, Shen Kuo, Yin Gong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画北宋「花石纲」（宋徽宗与艮岳）。时间1122 年，宋徽宗宣和四年。地点与格局：汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：山石剪影；中景：河水；主体：众人，太湖边，几百个民夫用绳索把一块巨大的石头从湖底拖上来。人物：宋徽宗（赵佶）、朱勔（苏州应奉局主持者）、蔡京（太师）、李师师（汴京名妓）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "The Flower and Rock Convoys: Emperor Huizong and the Genyue" in the Northern Song, 1122 CE. Place and layout: Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. This shot's composition and action: background: rock silhouettes; midground: river; subject: crowd, By Lake Tai hundreds of labourers haul a huge rock from the lakebed with ropes. Figures: Song Huizong, Zhu Mian, Cai Jing, Li Shishi. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是北宋「花石纲」（宋徽宗与艮岳），地点汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿，人物剪影：宋徽宗（赵佶）、朱勔（苏州应奉局主持者）、蔡京（太师）、李师师（汴京名妓）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "The Flower and Rock Convoys: Emperor Huizong and the Genyue" in the Northern Song, at Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. Silhouettes: Song Huizong, Zhu Mian, Cai Jing, Li Shishi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "The Flower and Rock Convoys: Emperor Huizong and the Genyue" in the Northern Song, Song Huizong, Zhu Mian, Cai Jing, Li Shishi, Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是北宋「靖康之变」（二帝北迁），地点汴京街市、虹桥、书院、宫殿，人物剪影：宋徽宗（赵佶）、宋钦宗（赵桓）、李纲（亲征行营使）、完颜宗望（金东路军统帅）、完颜宗翰（金西路军统帅）、郭京（自称能施六甲法者）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "The Jingkang Disaster: Two Emperors Taken North" in the Northern Song, at Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. Silhouettes: Song Huizong, Song Qinzong, Li Gang, Wanyan Zongwang, Wanyan Zonghan, Guo Jing. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "The Jingkang Disaster: Two Emperors Taken North" in the Northern Song, Song Huizong, Song Qinzong, Li Gang, Wanyan Zongwang, Wanyan Zonghan, Guo Jing, Bianjing streets, arched bridges, academies, palace halls. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「虎思斡耳朵」（耶律大石建西辽）。时间1124—1141 年，辽保大四年至西辽康国八年。地点与格局：草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：近山与地面、营帐；主体：耶律延禧、耶律大石，夹山中，辽的皇帝与林牙争执不下。人物：耶律大石（辽宗室、林牙，西辽德宗）、耶律延禧（辽天祚帝）、七州十八部（可敦城周边诸部）、桑贾尔（塞尔柱苏丹）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Balasagun: Yelü Dashi Founds the Western Liao" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, 1124 CE. Place and layout: steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields. This shot's composition and action: midground: near hills and ground, army tents; subject: Yelü Yanxi, Yelü Dashi, In the Jia mountains the Liao emperor and the scholar-general argue. Figures: Yelü Dashi, Yelü Yanxi, Qi Zhoushibabu, Sanjar. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「黄河九渡」（西夏亡）。时间1227 年六至七月，蒙古太祖二十二年，夏宝义二年。地点与格局：草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：河水；主体：骑兵，黄河两岸，蒙古骑兵分路渡河。人物：成吉思汗（蒙古太祖）、李睍（西夏末主）、耶律楚材（随军文臣）、古尔伯勒津（西夏王妃（传说人物））。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Nine Crossings of the Yellow River: the Fall of Western Xia" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, 1227 CE. Place and layout: steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: river; subject: cavalry, Mongol cavalry cross the Yellow River at several points. Figures: Genghis Khan, Li Xian, Yelü Chucai, Gürbeljin. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Nine Crossings of the Yellow River: the Fall of Western Xia" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, at steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields. Silhouettes: Genghis Khan, Li Xian, Yelü Chucai, Gürbeljin. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「蔡州」（金亡）。时间1233—1234 年，金天兴二年至三年。地点与格局：草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞、烟，汴京已破，哀宗南走。人物：金哀宗（完颜守绪）、完颜承麟（金末帝）、孟珙（宋将）、塔察儿（蒙古将领）、忠孝军将士（金军）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Caizhou: the Fall of Jin" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, 1233 CE. Place and layout: steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, smoke, Bianjing has fallen; Emperor Aizong flees south. Figures: Jin Aizong, Wanyan Chenglin, Meng Gong, Tachar, Zhong Xiaojunjiangshi. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是辽 · 西夏 · 金「蔡州」（金亡），地点草原毡帐、捺钵营地、城塞、雪原，人物剪影：金哀宗（完颜守绪）、完颜承麟（金末帝）、孟珙（宋将）、塔察儿（蒙古将领）、忠孝军将士（金军）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Caizhou: the Fall of Jin" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, at steppe felt tents, seasonal royal camps, frontier forts, snowfields. Silhouettes: Jin Aizong, Wanyan Chenglin, Meng Gong, Tachar, Zhong Xiaojunjiangshi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是南宋「黄天荡」（韩世忠与梁夫人），地点临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋，人物剪影：韩世忠（浙西制置使）、梁夫人（韩世忠之妻）、完颜宗弼（兀术，金军统帅）、献策者（福建人王某）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Huangtiandang: Han Shizhong and Lady Liang" in the Southern Song, at Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. Silhouettes: Han Shizhong, Lady Liang, Wanyan Zongbi, Xian Cezhe. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Huangtiandang: Han Shizhong and Lady Liang" in the Southern Song, Han Shizhong, Lady Liang, Wanyan Zongbi, Xian Cezhe, Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南宋「采石矶」（虞允文）。时间1161 年十一月，宋绍兴三十一年十一月。地点与格局：临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：山石剪影；中景：河水、近山与地面，采石矶，长江最窄处之一。人物：虞允文（中书舍人、督视府参谋军事）、完颜亮（金主）、时俊（统制）、王权（建康都统制）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Caishi Cliff: Yu Yunwen" in the Southern Song, 1161 CE. Place and layout: Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. This shot's composition and action: background: rock silhouettes; midground: river, near hills and ground, Caishi, one of the narrowest points of the Yangtze. Figures: Yu Yunwen, Wanyan Liang, Shi Jun, Wang Quan. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Caishi Cliff: Yu Yunwen" in the Southern Song, Yu Yunwen, Wanyan Liang, Shi Jun, Wang Quan, Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南宋「家祭无忘」（陆游）。时间1210 年一月，宋宁宗嘉定二年。地点与格局：临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。这一镜的构图与动作：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：秦桧，礼部的榜单上，陆游的名字原在前列，宰相的朱笔一划，名字没了。人物：陆游（字务观，号放翁）、秦桧（宰相）、王炎（四川宣抚使）、唐琬（陆游前妻）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Do Not Forget to Tell Me at the Family Altar: Lu You" in the Southern Song, 1210 CE. Place and layout: Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.  Figures: Lu You, Qin Gui, Wang Yan, Tang Wan. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是南宋「家祭无忘」（陆游），地点临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋，人物剪影：陆游（字务观，号放翁）、秦桧（宰相）、王炎（四川宣抚使）、唐琬（陆游前妻）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Do Not Forget to Tell Me at the Family Altar: Lu You" in the Southern Song, at Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. Silhouettes: Lu You, Qin Gui, Wang Yan, Tang Wan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南宋「钓鱼城」（上帝折鞭）。时间1243—1279 年，宋淳祐三年至祥兴二年。地点与格局：临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：河水，合州，嘉陵江、渠江、涪江三江交汇。人物：余玠（四川制置使）、冉琎（播州士人）、王坚（钓鱼城守将）、蒙哥（蒙古大汗）、王立（钓鱼城末任守将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Diaoyu Fortress: Where the Scourge of God Broke His Whip" in the Southern Song, 1243 CE. Place and layout: Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: river, Hezhou, where three rivers meet. Figures: Yu Jie, Ran Jin, Wang Jian, Möngke, Wang Li. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是南宋「钓鱼城」（上帝折鞭），地点临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋，人物剪影：余玠（四川制置使）、冉琎（播州士人）、王坚（钓鱼城守将）、蒙哥（蒙古大汗）、王立（钓鱼城末任守将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Diaoyu Fortress: Where the Scourge of God Broke His Whip" in the Southern Song, at Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. Silhouettes: Yu Jie, Ran Jin, Wang Jian, Möngke, Wang Li. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Diaoyu Fortress: Where the Scourge of God Broke His Whip" in the Southern Song, Yu Jie, Ran Jin, Wang Jian, Möngke, Wang Li, Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. One rise and fall, then rest.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是南宋「襄樊之战」（吕文焕），地点临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋，人物剪影：吕文焕（知襄阳府）、阿术（元军统帅）、刘整（元水军将领）、张顺（民兵部辖）、张贵（民兵都统）、亦思马因（回回炮匠）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "The Battle of Xiangfan: Lü Wenhuan" in the Southern Song, at Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. Silhouettes: Lü Wenhuan, A Shu, Liu Zheng, Zhang Shun, Zhang Gui, Ismail. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "The Battle of Xiangfan: Lü Wenhuan" in the Southern Song, Lü Wenhuan, A Shu, Liu Zheng, Zhang Shun, Zhang Gui, Ismail, Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南宋「崖山」（文天祥）。时间1279—1283 年，宋祥兴二年至元至元十九年。地点与格局：临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：江海、浪头，南海，崖门两山对峙。人物：文天祥（右丞相）、陆秀夫（左丞相）、张世杰（枢密副使）、赵昺（宋帝昺）、张弘范（元军统帅）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Yashan: Wen Tianxiang" in the Southern Song, 1279 CE. Place and layout: Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: sea, breaking waves, Twin hills of the Yamen strait on the South China Sea. Figures: Wen Tianxiang, Lu Xiufu, Zhang Shijie, Zhao Bing, Zhang Hongfan. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Yashan: Wen Tianxiang" in the Southern Song, Wen Tianxiang, Lu Xiufu, Zhang Shijie, Zhao Bing, Zhang Hongfan, Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画元「成吉思汗」（斡难河源）。时间1206 年，蒙古太祖元年。地点与格局：大都宫阙、草原毡帐、驿站、海船。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：草、河水，草原，斡难河。人物：铁木真（成吉思汗）、札木合（札答兰部首领）、孛儿帖（铁木真之妻）、王汗（克烈部首领）、阿兰豁阿（蒙古始祖母（传说））。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Genghis Khan: the Source of the Onon" in the Yuan, 1206 CE. Place and layout: Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: grass, river, The steppe and the Onon River. Figures: Temüjin, Jamukha, Bei Ertie, Wang Han, A Lanhuoa. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是元「成吉思汗」（斡难河源），地点大都宫阙、草原毡帐、驿站、海船，人物剪影：铁木真（成吉思汗）、札木合（札答兰部首领）、孛儿帖（铁木真之妻）、王汗（克烈部首领）、阿兰豁阿（蒙古始祖母（传说））。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Genghis Khan: the Source of the Onon" in the Yuan, at Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks. Silhouettes: Temüjin, Jamukha, Bei Ertie, Wang Han, A Lanhuoa. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画元「大都」（刘秉忠）。时间1267—1276 年，元至元四年至十三年。地点与格局：大都宫阙、草原毡帐、驿站、海船。这一镜的构图与动作：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面；主体：水，金中都的废墟旁，一片湖泊与荒地。人物：刘秉忠（太保，原为僧人子聪）、忽必烈（元世祖）、郭守敬（都水监）、也黑迭儿（茶迪儿匠人）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "Dadu: Liu Bingzhong" in the Yuan, 1267 CE. Place and layout: Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks. This shot's composition and action: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: water, A lake and wasteland beside the ruins of Jin Zhongdu. Figures: Liu Bingzhong, Kublai, Guo Shoujing, Ye Heidieer. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是元「大都」（刘秉忠），地点大都宫阙、草原毡帐、驿站、海船，人物剪影：刘秉忠（太保，原为僧人子聪）、忽必烈（元世祖）、郭守敬（都水监）、也黑迭儿（茶迪儿匠人）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "Dadu: Liu Bingzhong" in the Yuan, at Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks. Silhouettes: Liu Bingzhong, Kublai, Guo Shoujing, Ye Heidieer. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "Dadu: Liu Bingzhong" in the Yuan, Liu Bingzhong, Kublai, Guo Shoujing, Ye Heidieer, Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks. One rise and fall, then rest.
