Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "临安" in the Southern Song. Place and layout: Lin'an, the lake and the Qiantang.  Figures: Emperor Gaozong. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 淮河
scenes.subtitle: 一条国界
scenes.narrative: 绍兴和议规定宋金以淮水中流为界。一条原本用于灌溉和漕运的河，变成两个政权的边界，河边的州县从此是边镇。《宋史·高宗纪》记了划界。和议的朝堂谈判是治国场。本场只沿河走：北岸的金和南岸的宋，河本身是一道墨线。大散关是这条界在西边的另一个点，用淡墨标在远处。
scenes.placeEn: the Huai River and Dasan Pass

sources.title: 宋史
sources.notes: 绍兴十一年，以淮水中流划界

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南宋「淮河」（一条国界）。时间1141 年，宋绍兴十一年。地点与格局：淮河、大散关。人物：宋高宗（宋帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "淮河" in the Southern Song. Place and layout: the Huai River and Dasan Pass.  Figures: Emperor Gaozong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是南宋「淮河」（一条国界），地点淮河、大散关，人物剪影：宋高宗（宋帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "淮河" in the Southern Song, at the Huai River and Dasan Pass. Silhouettes: Emperor Gaozong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 会宁
scenes.subtitle: 金的上京
scenes.narrative: 阿骨打在收国元年称帝，以上京会宁府为都。会宁在按出虎水之侧，是女真兴起的地方，离后来的中都很远。《金史·地理志》写了上京路和会宁府。海陵王迁都燕京是几十年后的事。本场画一条河、一座还不大的城和周围的营帐，说明金的第一张地图中心在白山黑水，不在华北。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「会宁」（金的上京）。时间1115 年，金收国元年。地点与格局：会宁、按出虎水。人物：完颜阿骨打（金太祖）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "会宁" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin. Place and layout: Huining and the Ashi River.  Figures: Wanyan Aguda. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「会宁」（金的上京）。时间1115 年，金收国元年。地点与格局：会宁、按出虎水。人物：完颜阿骨打（金太祖）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "会宁" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin. Place and layout: Huining and the Ashi River.  Figures: Wanyan Aguda. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍朝会里衣袖轻动、地图上的墨线缓缓延伸、仓廪与渠水几乎静止，镜头缓推后定格。这一场是辽 · 西夏 · 金「会宁」（金的上京），地点会宁、按出虎水，人物剪影：完颜阿骨打（金太祖）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. This shot is "会宁" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, at Huining and the Ashi River. Silhouettes: Wanyan Aguda. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 中都
scenes.subtitle: 海陵迁燕
scenes.narrative: 海陵王完颜亮在贞元元年把都城从上京迁到燕京，改名中都，并拆掉上京的旧宫殿，表示不准备回去。《金史·海陵纪》写了迁都和毁上京。中都利用了辽南京的城址，金朝的重心从此进入华北平原。立马吴山是他后来的南征。本场只画一次向南的搬迁：上京变空，燕山脚下的城变实。

sources.title: 金史
sources.notes: 贞元元年迁都燕京，改中都

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「中都」（海陵迁燕）。时间1153 年，金贞元元年。地点与格局：中都、上京。人物：完颜亮（金海陵王）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 和林
scenes.subtitle: 蒙古的城

when.era: 蒙古太宗七年 · 宋端平二年
when.notes: 窝阔台没有使用宋的年号，端平是对照。

scenes.narrative: 窝阔台在蒙古本部建和林城，作为汗廷所在。它不在农耕地带，靠的是各地送来的人和物资，城内有回回、汉人的街区。《元史·地理志》在岭北行省下追记和林。忽必烈后来把政治中心南移到开平和大都，和林就变成北边的旧都。本场画草原上第一座被写成都城的城，和从它伸向南方的驿路。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画元「和林」（蒙古的城）。时间1235 年，蒙古太宗七年 · 宋端平二年。地点与格局：和林。人物：窝阔台（蒙古大汗）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "和林" in the Yuan. Place and layout: Karakorum.  Figures: Ögedei. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是元「和林」（蒙古的城），地点和林，人物剪影：窝阔台（蒙古大汗）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "和林" in the Yuan, at Karakorum. Silhouettes: Ögedei. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 会通河
scenes.subtitle: 郭守敬的运河
scenes.narrative: 至元二十六年，开凿从安山到临清的河道，把汶水和御河连起来，赐名会通河。几年后通惠河又把粮船引进大都城下。郭守敬主持了关键的测量和闸坝。《元史·河渠志》记了会通河的长度和闸。大都的城是刘秉忠那场。本场只画闸和水位：没有这些闸，山东的高地会把南北运河截断。

sources.title: 元史
sources.notes: 至元二十六年开会通河

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画元「会通河」（郭守敬的运河）。时间1289 年，元至元二十六年。地点与格局：会通河、临清、安山。人物：郭守敬（都水监）、忽必烈（元世祖）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "会通河" in the Yuan. Place and layout: the Huitong canal.  Figures: Guo Shoujing, Kublai Khan. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画元「会通河」（郭守敬的运河）。时间1289 年，元至元二十六年。地点与格局：会通河、临清、安山。人物：郭守敬（都水监）、忽必烈（元世祖）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "会通河" in the Yuan. Place and layout: the Huitong canal.  Figures: Guo Shoujing, Kublai Khan. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍朝会里衣袖轻动、地图上的墨线缓缓延伸、仓廪与渠水几乎静止，镜头缓推后定格。这一场是元「会通河」（郭守敬的运河），地点会通河、临清、安山，人物剪影：郭守敬（都水监）、忽必烈（元世祖）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. This shot is "会通河" in the Yuan, at the Huitong canal. Silhouettes: Guo Shoujing, Kublai Khan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 迁都北京
scenes.subtitle: 永乐十九年
scenes.narrative: 永乐元年朱棣已经把北平改为北京，十九年正式迁都，南京变成留都。宫殿沿用元大都的位置而略向南移，形成后来的中轴线。《明史·成祖纪》记了这一年的迁都。靖难是他夺取帝位的战争。本场是地图上的结果：明朝的重心从长江边挪到燕山脚下，运粮靠的仍是运河。

sources.title: 明史
sources.notes: 顺天府，永乐元年称北京

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画明「迁都北京」（永乐十九年）。时间1421 年，明永乐十九年。地点与格局：北京、南京。人物：朱棣（明成祖）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "迁都北京" in the Ming. Place and layout: Beijing and Nanjing. image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "迁都北京" in the Ming. Place and layout: Beijing and Nanjing.  Figures: Yongle Emperor. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 延绥边墙
scenes.subtitle: 余子俊
scenes.narrative: 成化十年，延绥巡抚余子俊在黄土高原的北边修筑边墙，把营堡移到墙内，用来阻挡河套的骑兵。《明史·余子俊传》写了这次工程的长度和他与朝中反对者的争执。明长城不是一条一次修成的线，延绥这一段是其中有明确主持人的一段。本场画黄土梁上的墙和墙内的堡，不把秦长城和它画成同一道。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画明「延绥边墙」（余子俊）。时间1474 年，明成化十年。地点与格局：延绥、榆林。人物：余子俊（延绥巡抚）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "延绥边墙" in the Ming. Place and layout: Yansui and Yulin.  Figures: Yu Zijun. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是明「延绥边墙」（余子俊），地点延绥、榆林，人物剪影：余子俊（延绥巡抚）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "延绥边墙" in the Ming, at Yansui and Yulin. Silhouettes: Yu Zijun. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "延绥边墙" in the Ming. Place and layout: Yansui and Yulin.  Figures: Yu Zijun. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. scenes.title: 辽西走廊
scenes.subtitle: 山海之间的关

when.notes: 筑关之年方志多系洪武十四年，本场取约数，以地理志所载关隘为准。

scenes.narrative: 山海关在辽西走廊的最窄处，一边是山，一边是海。《明史·地理志》把它系在永平府抚宁县下，是明朝对辽东和蒙古方向的主要关口。吴三桂开关是崇祯十七年的事，已有专场。本场只画这座关的地形：山、海和中间只能通过一支军队的城门。不把“天下第一关”的匾写进画面，字是后来加的。

sources.title: 明史
sources.notes: 洪武中修北边关隘，山海关之筑系于此时，年份取约

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画明「辽西走廊」（山海之间的关）。时间约洪武十四年，明洪武十四年前后。地点与格局：山海关、辽西走廊。人物：徐达（明将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「辽西走廊」（山海之间的关）。时间约洪武十四年，明洪武十四年前后。地点与格局：山海关、辽西走廊。人物：徐达（明将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "辽西走廊" in the Ming. Place and layout: Shanhai Pass.  Figures: Xu Da. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是明「辽西走廊」（山海之间的关），地点山海关、辽西走廊，人物剪影：徐达（明将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "辽西走廊" in the Ming, at Shanhai Pass. Silhouettes: Xu Da. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 台湾府
scenes.subtitle: 康熙二十三年
scenes.narrative: 施琅取下台湾的第二年，清朝没有按一部分大臣的意见放弃海岛，而是设台湾府，下辖台湾、凤山、诸罗三县，隶属福建省。《清史稿·地理志》和《圣祖本纪》都记了设府。郑成功收复是军事场。本场是行政地理：一座府城、三座县城，和把它们连到厦门的海路。不把今天的省界画上去。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 康熙二十三年设台湾府

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画清「台湾府」（康熙二十三年）。时间1684 年，清康熙二十三年。地点与格局：台湾府、厦门。人物：康熙帝（清帝）、施琅（水师提督）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "台湾府" in the Qing. Place and layout: Taiwan Prefecture and Xiamen. scenes.title: 伊犁
scenes.subtitle: 新疆的枢纽
scenes.narrative: 乾隆二十到二十四年，清朝平定准部和回部，在伊犁设将军，总统天山南北的军政。《清史稿·地理志》把伊犁写成新疆的重心，惠远城是将军驻地。左宗棠收复是一百多年后的事。本场画伊犁河谷和从那里伸向塔里木、伸向蒙古的路，说明十八世纪中叶清朝的地图在这里收了一个结。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 乾隆二十四年平定回部

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画清「伊犁」（新疆的枢纽）。时间1759 年，清乾隆二十四年。地点与格局：伊犁、惠远。人物：乾隆帝（清帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "伊犁" in the Qing. Place and layout: Ili and Huiyuan.  Figures: Qianlong Emperor. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是清「伊犁」（新疆的枢纽），地点伊犁、惠远，人物剪影：乾隆帝（清帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "伊犁" in the Qing, at Ili and Huiyuan. Silhouettes: Qianlong Emperor. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是清「伊犁」（新疆的枢纽），地点伊犁、惠远，人物剪影：乾隆帝（清帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "伊犁" in the Qing, at Ili and Huiyuan. Silhouettes: Qianlong Emperor. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 五口
scenes.subtitle: 南京之约
scenes.narrative: 道光二十二年，耆英与英国代表在南京定约，广州、福州、厦门、宁波、上海五处开口岸，并割让香港岛。《清史稿·邦交志》记录了这五口。它改变的是海岸的法律地位：五个点从只许行商的广州体系里被单独打开。本场画海岸线上的五个墨点，不画条约的英文字，也不把后来的租界街道画进道光二十二年。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 道光二十二年南京约，五口通商

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画清「五口」（南京之约）。时间1842 年，清道光二十二年。地点与格局：广州、福州、厦门、宁波、上海。人物：耆英（钦差大臣）、道光帝（清帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "五口" in the Qing. Place and layout: the five ports.  Figures: Qiying, Daoguang Emperor. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画清「五口」（南京之约）。时间1842 年，清道光二十二年。地点与格局：广州、福州、厦门、宁波、上海。人物：耆英（钦差大臣）、道光帝（清帝）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "五口" in the Qing. Place and layout: the five ports.  Figures: Qiying, Daoguang Emperor. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍朝会里衣袖轻动、地图上的墨线缓缓延伸、仓廪与渠水几乎静止，镜头缓推后定格。这一场是清「五口」（南京之约），地点广州、福州、厦门、宁波、上海，人物剪影：耆英（钦差大臣）、道光帝（清帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. This shot is "五口" in the Qing, at the five ports. Silhouettes: Qiying, Daoguang Emperor. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 铜瓦厢
scenes.subtitle: 黄河改道
scenes.narrative: 咸丰五年六月，黄河在兰阳铜瓦厢决口，河道从南边的淮河一线摆回北边，经山东夺大清河入海。这是黄河近几百年里最重要的一次改道。《清史稿·河渠志》记了决口和此后北流的事实。它不是一场战争，但战场、漕运和山东的州县都被这条新河改写。本场画决口处和一条向东北的新墨线，旧河道用淡灰留着。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 咸丰五年铜瓦厢决，河北徙

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画清「铜瓦厢」（黄河改道）。时间1855 年，清咸丰五年。地点与格局：铜瓦厢、兰阳。人物：咸丰帝（清帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。

Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "铜瓦厢" in the Qing. Place and layout: Tongwaxiang.  Figures: Xianfeng Emperor. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "铜瓦厢" in the Qing, at Tongwaxiang. Silhouettes: Xianfeng Emperor. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 渭水垂钓
scenes.subtitle: 太公望

when.notes: 钓鱼遇文王是史公采用的传说，年份不考。

scenes.narrative: 《史记·齐太伯世家》说吕尚穷困，年老钓于渭滨，西伯出猎和他谈话，高兴地说“吾太公望子久矣”，于是称太公望，一起回去。牧野之战里的师尚父是这个人的后一半，已有专场。本场只取渭水边的相遇。钓鱼的细节像小说，司马迁自己也用了“或曰”保存异说，所以画面保持留白，不把封神故事里的法宝画进去。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 吕尚钓于渭滨，西伯载与俱归

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画西周「渭水垂钓」（太公望）。时间传说，在牧野之前，商末（年号未行）。地点与格局：渭水。人物：吕尚（渭滨钓者）、周文王（西伯）。一尊无五官的黑色剪影肖像，只留冠帽、袖摆与一件器物的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态表达转折。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "渭水垂钓" in the Western Zhou. Place and layout: the Wei River.  Figures: Lü Shang, King Wen of Zhou. one faceless black silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and a single object, about 7 heads tall, the pose carrying the turn. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is this person's leitmotif: a short phrase on one instrument, repeated, only growing or thinning with the life, lots of rest, pentatonic, no lyrics. This cue: "渭水垂钓" in the Western Zhou, Lü Shang, King Wen of Zhou, the Wei River. One rise and fall, then rest.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画西周「渭水垂钓」（太公望）。时间传说，在牧野之前，商末（年号未行）。地点与格局：渭水。人物：吕尚（渭滨钓者）、周文王（西伯）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "渭水垂钓" in the Western Zhou. Place and layout: the Wei River.  Figures: Lü Shang, King Wen of Zhou. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "渭水垂钓" in the Western Zhou, at the Wei River. Silhouettes: Lü Shang, King Wen of Zhou. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 泛舟五湖
scenes.subtitle: 范蠡

when.era: 越王勾践灭吴之后（年号未行）

scenes.narrative: 勾践灭吴，范蠡以为大名之下难以久居，离开越国，从海上走，后来在陶做买卖，人称陶朱公。《史记·越王勾践世家》写他写信给文种，劝文种也走，文种不走，果然被赐死。西施随他而去是后世小说，史公没有写。本场只画一只离开会稽的船和没有回头的人。卧薪尝胆是战争那场，这里是离开。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画春秋「泛舟五湖」（范蠡）。时间约前 473 年，越王勾践灭吴之后（年号未行）。地点与格局：五湖、陶。人物：范蠡（越大夫）、文种（越大夫）、勾践（越王）。一尊无五官的黑色剪影肖像，只留冠帽、袖摆与一件器物的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态表达转折。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. scenes.title: 悲愤
scenes.subtitle: 蔡琰归汉

when.notes: 曹操赎回蔡琰的年份史无月日，取建安中。

scenes.narrative: 蔡邕的女儿蔡琰在乱中被胡骑掳去，在南匈奴生活了十二年，曹操把她赎回，再嫁董祀。她凭记忆写下父亲留给她的书，又作《悲愤诗》写流离。《后汉书·列女传》保存了这段和两首诗的文本。诗里的细节有文学加工，被赎这件事本身见于传。本场画归途上的一个女剪影和两名不能带走的孩子，这是诗里的情节，画面注明出自她的自述。

sources.title: 后汉书
sources.notes: 蔡琰没于南匈奴，曹操赎归

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。人物主线。以一尊无五官的剪影肖像为中心，只留冠帽、袖摆与器物的大轮廓，姿态表达这一生的转折；背景大面积留白。朱红不超过一成，多半不用。这一帧画新 · 东汉「悲愤」（蔡琰归汉）。时间约建安中，汉建安十三年前后。地点与格局：南匈奴、邺。人物：蔡琰（董祀妻）、曹操（汉丞相）。一尊无五官的黑色剪影肖像，只留冠帽、袖摆与一件器物的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态表达转折。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). A person is the main line: one faceless silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and one object, the pose carrying a turn in the life. Generous empty ground. Vermilion under ten percent, often none. This still is "悲愤" in the Eastern Han. Place and layout: the Southern Xiongnu and Ye.  Figures: Cai Yan, Cao Cao. one faceless black silhouette portrait, only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves and a single object, about 7 heads tall, the pose carrying the turn. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画新 · 东汉「悲愤」（蔡琰归汉）。时间约建安中，汉建安十三年前后。地点与格局：南匈奴、邺。人物：蔡琰（董祀妻）、曹操（汉丞相）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "悲愤" in the Eastern Han. Place and layout: the Southern Xiongnu and Ye.  Figures: Cai Yan, Cao Cao. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是新 · 东汉「悲愤」（蔡琰归汉），地点南匈奴、邺，人物剪影：蔡琰（董祀妻）、曹操（汉丞相）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "悲愤" in the Eastern Han, at the Southern Xiongnu and Ye. Silhouettes: Cai Yan, Cao Cao. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 千亩之战
scenes.subtitle: 败于姜戎

when.era: 周宣王三十九年（年号未行）
when.notes: 宣王元年按前 827 年计，三十九年为前 789 年。

scenes.narrative: 周宣王前期还有“中兴”的名声，晚岁却在千亩被姜氏之戎打垮，连调来的“南国之师”也折了。《史记·周本纪》把这一仗和宣王此后不修籍田、败于申侯之祸连在一起看：西周的兵力从这里开始不够用。千亩的位置有山西、关中两说，本场只把它当作戎人熟悉、王师不熟的一块坡地。和宣王早年对玁狁的反击不是同一场。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 宣王三十九年，战于千亩，王师败绩于姜氏之戎

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画西周「千亩之战」（败于姜戎）。时间前 789 年，周宣王三十九年（年号未行）。地点与格局：千亩。人物：周宣王（周天子）、姜氏之戎（敌对部族）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "千亩之战" in the Western Zhou. Place and layout: Qianmu.  Figures: King Xuan of Zhou, Jiang Rong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 柏举之战
scenes.subtitle: 吴师入郢

when.era: 周敬王十四年 · 鲁定公四年（年号未行）

scenes.narrative: 吴王阖闾用伍子胥、孙武，从淮水一线西进，在柏举大破楚令尹囊瓦的军队，接着五战五胜，攻进郢都。楚昭王出逃。吴人在郢的暴行和后来秦国出兵救楚、吴师退走，都写在《左传》定公四年、五年。这一仗把长江中游的霸权从楚国手里打出一条缝，也是孙武之名进入史书战争记载的关键一役。本场画汉水以东的军阵和空了的郢都，不把西施故事掺进来。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画春秋「柏举之战」（吴师入郢）。时间前 506 年，周敬王十四年 · 鲁定公四年（年号未行）。地点与格局：柏举、郢。人物：阖闾（吴王）、伍子胥（吴行人）、孙武（吴将）、囊瓦（楚令尹）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "柏举之战" in the Spring and Autumn period. Place and layout: Boju and Ying.  Figures: Helü, Wu Zixu, Sun Wu, Nang Wa. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

This shot is "柏举之战" in the Spring and Autumn period, at Boju and Ying. Silhouettes: Helü, Wu Zixu, Sun Wu, Nang Wa. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

negative.zh: 不要现代环境声。不出现任何现代元素：现代建筑、电线、电线杆、公路、车辆、玻璃、塑料、现代服饰、眼镜、手表、枪械、电灯、招牌或文字标识。不出现时代错置之物：西式王冠、尖刺王冠、欧式王冠、礼帽、羽毛头饰、印第安羽冠、尖顶兜帽长袍、三K党兜帽、日本鸟居、日式建筑、武士刀、高速公路、柏油路、车道线、登山杖、双肩背包、徒步者、喷气式飞机、飞机、导弹、台灯、灯罩、灯泡、玻璃灯罩、玻璃窗、玻璃马车、欧式驿马车、美式篷车、招牌、带字匾额、旗上徽记、圆形徽章、标志、藏青色天空、蓝色调、青色、黄色、橙色、佛塔、窣堵坡、多层楼阁塔、纸灯笼、红灯笼、线装书、书本、西洋大帆船、方帆船、蒸汽船、格子桅杆、烟囱、铁甲舰

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画春秋「柏举之战」（吴师入郢）。时间前 506 年，周敬王十四年 · 鲁定公四年（年号未行）。地点与格局：柏举、郢。人物：阖闾（吴王）、伍子胥（吴行人）、孙武（吴将）、囊瓦（楚令尹）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "柏举之战" in the Spring and Autumn period. Place and layout: Boju and Ying.  Figures: Helü, Wu Zixu, Sun Wu, Nang Wa. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是春秋「柏举之战」（吴师入郢），地点柏举、郢，人物剪影：阖闾（吴王）、伍子胥（吴行人）、孙武（吴将）、囊瓦（楚令尹）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "柏举之战" in the Spring and Autumn period, at Boju and Ying. Silhouettes: Helü, Wu Zixu, Sun Wu, Nang Wa. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐开阔：长音如风沿着地图上的河走远，低而慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要紧促的战鼓。本场：春秋「柏举之战」（吴师入郢），阖闾（吴王）、伍子胥（吴行人）、孙武（吴将）、囊瓦（楚令尹），柏举、郢。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "柏举之战" in the Spring and Autumn period, Helü, Wu Zixu, Sun Wu, Nang Wa, Boju and Ying. One rise and fall, then rest.

scenes.title: 济西之战
scenes.subtitle: 乐毅伐齐

when.era: 周赧王三十一年 · 燕昭王二十八年（年号未行）
when.notes: 燕昭王元年传统系于前 311 年，二十八年为前 284 年。

scenes.narrative: 燕昭王为了报复齐国早年的入侵，筑黄金台招揽乐毅。乐毅联合秦、楚、三晋，在济西击破齐军，随即长驱，下齐城七十余座，只剩下莒和即墨。齐湣王出逃，后来死在莒。这一仗和后来田单的火牛复齐是同一场战争的两头：先是齐国几乎亡国，再是即墨的翻盘。本场只写济西的会战和空城，火牛留给已有的田单一场。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 乐毅破齐于济西，下齐七十余城

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 湣王四十年，燕将乐毅入临淄

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画战国「济西之战」（乐毅伐齐）。时间前 284 年，周赧王三十一年 · 燕昭王二十八年（年号未行）。地点与格局：济西。人物：乐毅（燕上将军）、燕昭王（燕君）、齐湣王（齐君）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "济西之战" in the Warring States. Place and layout: west of the Ji River.  Figures: Yue Yi, King Zhao of Yan, King Min of Qi. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是战国「济西之战」（乐毅伐齐），地点济西，人物剪影：乐毅（燕上将军）、燕昭王（燕君）、齐湣王（齐君）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "济西之战" in the Warring States, at west of the Ji River. Silhouettes: Yue Yi, King Zhao of Yan, King Min of Qi. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 王翦灭楚
scenes.subtitle: 六十万

when.era: 秦王政二十三年（年号未行）
when.notes: 秦王政元年为前 246 年，二十三年为前 224 年；次年虏负刍。

scenes.narrative: 秦王政想迅速灭楚，先听李信说二十万够了，李信被楚军击败。王翦坚持非六十万不可，得到兵权后却按兵不动，让士卒投石超距，等楚军松懈再出击，追到蕲南，杀项燕，次年虏楚王负刍。司马迁把重点放在用兵的耐心，而不是一夜破城。楚地大、粮道长，所以这是一场以休整和追击写成的灭国之战。和后来项羽的楚不是同一个楚。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 王翦率六十万灭楚，杀项燕

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 二十三年，王翦虏楚王负刍

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画战国「王翦灭楚」（六十万）。时间前 224 年，秦王政二十三年（年号未行）。地点与格局：蕲南、楚。人物：王翦（秦将）、秦王政（秦王）、项燕（楚将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "王翦灭楚" in the Warring States. Place and layout: Qinan, in Chu.  Figures: Wang Jian, Ying Zheng, Xiang Yan. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画战国「王翦灭楚」（六十万）。时间前 224 年，秦王政二十三年（年号未行）。地点与格局：蕲南、楚。人物：王翦（秦将）、秦王政（秦王）、项燕（楚将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "王翦灭楚" in the Warring States. Place and layout: Qinan, in Chu.  Figures: Wang Jian, Ying Zheng, Xiang Yan. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是战国「王翦灭楚」（六十万），地点蕲南、楚，人物剪影：王翦（秦将）、秦王政（秦王）、项燕（楚将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "王翦灭楚" in the Warring States, at Qinan, in Chu. Silhouettes: Wang Jian, Ying Zheng, Xiang Yan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 潍水之战
scenes.subtitle: 韩信破齐
scenes.narrative: 韩信已经用计拿下齐地，楚国派龙且来救。有人劝龙且深壁，让齐人自己反汉，龙且不听，要速战。韩信在潍水上游用沙囊堵住水，军半渡时撤囊，楚军被冲散，龙且被杀。齐地从此归汉。这一仗常被看成韩信用地形打的最干净的一仗：不是硬碰，是把河变成武器。本场的主线是潍水和两岸的军阵。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「潍水之战」（韩信破齐）。时间前 203 年，汉王四年（年号未行）。地点与格局：潍水。人物：韩信（汉将）、龙且（楚将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "潍水之战" in the Western Han. Place and layout: Wei River in Qi.  Figures: Han Xin, Long Ju. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 收河南地
scenes.subtitle: 卫青出云中
scenes.narrative: 元朔二年，卫青出云中，沿黄河北岸向西打到陇西，赶走匈奴白羊、楼烦王，把秦朝丢掉的“河南地”收回来，汉朝在那里设朔方郡。这是漠北大战之前的一次收复，意义在地图：匈奴失去了南下威胁长安的跳板。司马迁写卫青这次“走白羊、楼烦王”，不写一场有名字的对阵厮杀。本场以河套的空旷和新建的障塞为主。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「收河南地」（卫青出云中）。时间前 127 年，汉武帝元朔二年。地点与格局：河南地、云中、朔方。人物：卫青（大将军）、汉武帝（汉帝）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "收河南地" in the Western Han. Place and layout: the Ordos bend.  Figures: Wei Qing, Emperor Wu of Han. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是楚汉 · 西汉「收河南地」（卫青出云中），地点河南地、云中、朔方，人物剪影：卫青（大将军）、汉武帝（汉帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "收河南地" in the Western Han, at the Ordos bend. Silhouettes: Wei Qing, Emperor Wu of Han. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「收河南地」（卫青出云中）。时间前 127 年，汉武帝元朔二年。地点与格局：河南地、云中、朔方。人物：卫青（大将军）、汉武帝（汉帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "收河南地" in the Western Han. Place and layout: the Ordos bend.  Figures: Wei Qing, Emperor Wu of Han. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是楚汉 · 西汉「收河南地」（卫青出云中），地点河南地、云中、朔方，人物剪影：卫青（大将军）、汉武帝（汉帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "收河南地" in the Western Han, at the Ordos bend. Silhouettes: Wei Qing, Emperor Wu of Han. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "收河南地" in the Western Han, Wei Qing, Emperor Wu of Han, the Ordos bend. One rise and fall, then rest.

scenes.title: 灭南越
scenes.subtitle: 楼船与伏波
scenes.narrative: 南越相吕嘉杀汉使、立新王。元鼎六年，路博德为伏波将军，杨仆为楼船将军，分兵出桂阳、豫章、零陵和巴蜀，会师番禺。番禺城火起后，吕嘉夜间逃出，被追获。南越从此设为汉郡。这是一场沿江、沿海的远征，不是中原车战。本场画楼船、江雾和番禺的城郭，不把汉代还没有的海图仪器画进去。

sources.title: 史记
sources.notes: 元鼎六年楼船、伏波灭南越

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「灭南越」（楼船与伏波）。时间前 111 年，汉武帝元鼎六年。地点与格局：番禺、离水。人物：路博德（伏波将军）、杨仆（楼船将军）、吕嘉（南越相）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "灭南越" in the Western Han. Place and layout: Panyu.  Figures: Lu Bode, Yang Pu, Lü Jia. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. scenes.title: 射虎谷
scenes.subtitle: 段颎破羌
scenes.narrative: 东汉对西羌的战争打了几十年，段颎主张把兵力用尽，反对朝里“招降省费”的办法。建宁二年，他把东羌追进射虎谷，在山谷上下设防，最后把这支羌人军队击破。《后汉书》对他的评价很分裂：军功写得很满，杀人的规模也写得很满。本场取山谷、长墙和相持，不把史书里的斩首数字画成风景。这和窦宪燕然勒石不是同一场北边的战争。

sources.title: 后汉书
sources.notes: 建宁二年追羌至射虎谷，大破之

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画新 · 东汉「射虎谷」（段颎破羌）。时间169 年，汉灵帝建宁二年。地点与格局：射虎谷。人物：段颎（护羌校尉）、东羌（羌人部众）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "射虎谷" in the Eastern Han. Place and layout: Shehu Valley.  Figures: Duan Jiong, the Eastern Qiang. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

This shot is "射虎谷" in the Eastern Han, at Shehu Valley. Silhouettes: Duan Jiong, the Eastern Qiang. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画新 · 东汉「射虎谷」（段颎破羌）。时间169 年，汉灵帝建宁二年。地点与格局：射虎谷。人物：段颎（护羌校尉）、东羌（羌人部众）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "射虎谷" in the Eastern Han. Place and layout: Shehu Valley.  Figures: Duan Jiong, the Eastern Qiang. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是新 · 东汉「射虎谷」（段颎破羌），地点射虎谷，人物剪影：段颎（护羌校尉）、东羌（羌人部众）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "射虎谷" in the Eastern Han, at Shehu Valley. Silhouettes: Duan Jiong, the Eastern Qiang. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.
