scenes.title: 石亭之战
scenes.subtitle: 陆逊破曹休

when.era: 魏太和二年 · 吴黄武七年

scenes.narrative: 魏将曹休听信吴人周鲂的诈降，率兵深入皖地。陆逊在石亭设伏，三路齐进，曹休的军队自相践踏，弃甲逃走。孙权事先还把这支大军的中路交给陆逊统一调度。这是夷陵之后陆逊又一次把追击写成伏击的仗，也是吴国在江北能打赢的少数会战之一。本场画皖口的山道和弃在路上的旗帜，不画刀剑相交。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画三国「石亭之战」（陆逊破曹休）。时间228 年，魏太和二年 · 吴黄武七年。地点与格局：石亭、皖。人物：陆逊（吴大都督）、曹休（魏大司马）、周鲂（吴将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "石亭之战" in the Three Kingdoms. Place and layout: Shiting.  Figures: Lu Xun, Cao Xiu, Zhou Fang. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是三国「石亭之战」（陆逊破曹休），地点石亭、皖，人物剪影：陆逊（吴大都督）、曹休（魏大司马）、周鲂（吴将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "石亭之战" in the Three Kingdoms, at Shiting. Silhouettes: Lu Xun, Cao Xiu, Zhou Fang. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画三国「石亭之战」（陆逊破曹休）。时间228 年，魏太和二年 · 吴黄武七年。地点与格局：石亭、皖。人物：陆逊（吴大都督）、曹休（魏大司马）、周鲂（吴将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "石亭之战" in the Three Kingdoms. Place and layout: Shiting.  Figures: Lu Xun, Cao Xiu, Zhou Fang. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 参合陂
scenes.subtitle: 拓跋珪破慕容宝

when.era: 东晋太元二十年 · 北魏登国十年

scenes.narrative: 后燕慕容宝率大军伐魏，拓跋珪把燕军引到参合陂。燕人觉得魏军已经远走，夜晚不设防。魏军清晨从陂上压下来，燕军溃乱，落水和被俘的人极多。慕容宝单骑逃走。这一仗让北魏从草原部落变成能吃掉中原边镇的力量，后燕从此一蹶不振。《魏书》和《晋书·慕容垂载记》都写了，细节互有出入，本场取双方都承认的结果：燕军在陂下崩了。

sources.title: 魏书
sources.notes: 登国十年破慕容宝于参合陂

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画两晋「参合陂」（拓跋珪破慕容宝）。时间395 年，东晋太元二十年 · 北魏登国十年。地点与格局：参合陂。人物：拓跋珪（魏王）、慕容宝（燕太子）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "参合陂" in the Jin. Place and layout: Canhe Slope.  Figures: Tuoba Gui, Murong Bao. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是两晋「参合陂」（拓跋珪破慕容宝），地点参合陂，人物剪影：拓跋珪（魏王）、慕容宝（燕太子）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "参合陂" in the Jin, at Canhe Slope. Silhouettes: Tuoba Gui, Murong Bao. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 钟离之战
scenes.subtitle: 邵阳洲

when.era: 梁天监六年 · 魏正始四年

scenes.narrative: 北魏中山王元英围梁国钟离，在淮水上的邵阳洲架桥，兵号称很盛。城中守将昌义之用泥补被炮石打坏的城垛。梁武帝先派曹景宗，再派韦叡赶去。韦叡的军队连夜筑营，火攻洲上的桥。魏军从桥上退下时互相拥挤，淮水为之不流是史书的夸张说法，至少说明溃退发生在水上。钟离因此成为南朝少数守住了的江淮重镇。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南北朝「钟离之战」（邵阳洲）。时间507 年，梁天监六年 · 魏正始四年。地点与格局：钟离、邵阳洲。人物：韦叡（梁将）、昌义之（梁太守）、元英（魏中山王）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "钟离之战" in the Northern and Southern dynasties. Place and layout: Zhongli and Shaoyang Island.  Figures: Wei Rui, Chang Yizhi, Yuan Ying. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "钟离之战" in the Northern and Southern dynasties. Place and layout: Zhongli and Shaoyang Island. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.narrative: 高欢的东魏军队渡河，号称兵多。宇文泰的西魏兵少，在沙苑的芦苇荡里把部队分成左右埋伏。东魏兵看见西魏人少，争着向前，队形散了，伏兵从芦苇里出来，东魏大败，丢掉大量甲仗。沙苑让西魏在关中站住，东西对峙从此成为定局。本场用芦苇、河滩和稀疏的西魏旗帜，不把后来隋唐的府兵制度提前画出来。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南北朝「沙苑之战」（宇文泰以寡击众）。时间537 年，西魏大统三年 · 东魏天平四年。地点与格局：沙苑、渭水。人物：宇文泰（西魏丞相）、高欢（东魏权臣）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "沙苑之战" in the Northern and Southern dynasties. Place and layout: Shayuan.  Figures: Yuwen Tai, Gao Huan. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是南北朝「沙苑之战」（宇文泰以寡击众），地点沙苑、渭水，人物剪影：宇文泰（西魏丞相）、高欢（东魏权臣）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "沙苑之战" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, at Shayuan. Silhouettes: Yuwen Tai, Gao Huan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：南北朝「沙苑之战」（宇文泰以寡击众），宇文泰（西魏丞相）、高欢（东魏权臣），沙苑、渭水。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "沙苑之战" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, Yuwen Tai, Gao Huan, Shayuan. One rise and fall, then rest.

scenes.title: 浅水原
scenes.subtitle: 薛举父子
scenes.narrative: 武德元年，薛举从金城东进，在浅水原打败唐军，李世民因为生病没有亲自把整场仗管住。薛举不久病死，儿子薛仁杲继续围折墌。李世民先坚壁，等对方粮尽气衰，再在浅水原出击，追到折墌城下，薛仁杲投降。同一块原，先败后胜，旧唐书把两次都记在这一年。本场按时间画两阵之间的空营，不把后来的玄武门提前进来。

sources.title: 旧唐书
sources.notes: 武德元年浅水原败薛举、降薛仁杲

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「浅水原」（薛举父子）。时间618 年，唐武德元年。地点与格局：浅水原、折墌。人物：李世民（秦王）、薛举（西秦霸王）、薛仁杲（薛举之子）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "浅水原" in the Tang. Place and layout: Qianshuiyuan.  Figures: Li Shimin, Xue Ju, Xue Rengao. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画唐「浅水原」（薛举父子）。时间618 年，唐武德元年。地点与格局：浅水原、折墌。人物：李世民（秦王）、薛举（西秦霸王）、薛仁杲（薛举之子）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "浅水原" in the Tang. Place and layout: Qianshuiyuan.  Figures: Li Shimin, Xue Ju, Xue Rengao. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是唐「浅水原」（薛举父子），地点浅水原、折墌，人物剪影：李世民（秦王）、薛举（西秦霸王）、薛仁杲（薛举之子）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "浅水原" in the Tang, at Qianshuiyuan. Silhouettes: Li Shimin, Xue Ju, Xue Rengao. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 安市
scenes.subtitle: 贞观征辽
scenes.narrative: 贞观十九年，唐太宗亲自东征高丽。安市城外，高延寿、高惠真的援军被李世民击破，但安市城本身久攻不下。秋天草枯水冻，唐军退兵，太宗把失败归到自己不该亲自远征。两唐书没有“一将守城、皇帝受挫于某人姓名”的传奇说法，那些姓名是后来的小说。本场只画辽东的土城、城外的唐营和向西撤回的道路。

sources.title: 旧唐书
sources.notes: 贞观十九年攻安市，班师

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「安市」（贞观征辽）。时间645 年，唐太宗贞观十九年。地点与格局：安市、辽东。人物：唐太宗（唐帝）、高延寿（高丽将）、李勣（唐将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "安市" in the Tang. Place and layout: Anshi, Liaodong.  Figures: Emperor Taizong, Gao Yanshou, Li Ji. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是唐「安市」（贞观征辽），地点安市、辽东，人物剪影：唐太宗（唐帝）、高延寿（高丽将）、李勣（唐将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "安市" in the Tang, at Anshi, Liaodong. Silhouettes: Emperor Taizong, Gao Yanshou, Li Ji. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画唐「安市」（贞观征辽）。时间645 年，唐太宗贞观十九年。地点与格局：安市、辽东。人物：唐太宗（唐帝）、高延寿（高丽将）、李勣（唐将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "安市" in the Tang. Place and layout: Anshi, Liaodong.  Figures: Emperor Taizong, Gao Yanshou, Li Ji. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 香积寺
scenes.subtitle: 收复长安
scenes.narrative: 马嵬之后肃宗在灵武即位，郭子仪、李嗣业等从凤翔反攻长安。至德二载九月，唐军和回纥兵在香积寺北与安守忠、李归仁接战，把叛军赶进长安城，当晚长安收复。史书强调的是城西的会战和回纥骑兵从侧翼加入，不是巷战的细节。本场画香积寺外的平原和向城门退去的旗帜。杨贵妃之死已经在马嵬一场里，这里不再重复。

sources.title: 旧唐书
sources.notes: 至德二载香积寺之战，收复长安

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「香积寺」（收复长安）。时间757 年，唐肃宗至德二载。地点与格局：香积寺、长安。人物：郭子仪（唐副元帅）、李嗣业（唐将）、安守忠（燕将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "香积寺" in the Tang. Place and layout: Xiangji Temple, west of Chang'an.  Figures: Guo Ziyi, Li Siye, An Shouzhong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是唐「香积寺」（收复长安），地点香积寺、长安，人物剪影：郭子仪（唐副元帅）、李嗣业（唐将）、安守忠（燕将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "香积寺" in the Tang, at Xiangji Temple, west of Chang'an. Silhouettes: Guo Ziyi, Li Siye, An Shouzhong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 河阳之战
scenes.subtitle: 李光弼
scenes.narrative: 乾元二年，史思明在相州打败九节度的联军之后南下。李光弼放弃洛阳，把军队收缩到河阳的三城，背靠黄河，用城北、中潬和南城互相支援。史思明攻城不利，自己在河清被射伤。河阳没有把叛军消灭，但把东都空出来换了一条守得住的河防线。本场画黄河里的中潬城和两岸的栅栏，不画洛阳宫殿里的宴饮。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「河阳之战」（李光弼）。时间759 年，唐肃宗乾元二年。地点与格局：河阳、中潬。人物：李光弼（唐太尉）、史思明（燕帝）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "河阳之战" in the Tang. Place and layout: Heyang and the mid-river fort.  Figures: Li Guangbi, Shi Siming. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画唐「河阳之战」（李光弼）。时间759 年，唐肃宗乾元二年。地点与格局：河阳、中潬。人物：李光弼（唐太尉）、史思明（燕帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "河阳之战" in the Tang. Place and layout: Heyang and the mid-river fort.  Figures: Li Guangbi, Shi Siming. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 高梁河
scenes.subtitle: 宋辽首次大战

when.era: 宋太平兴国四年 · 辽乾亨元年

scenes.narrative: 太平兴国四年，宋太宗灭北汉后不停脚，直接去攻辽南京。城下宋军已经疲敝。辽将耶律沙在高梁河与宋军接触，耶律休哥和耶律斜轸随后赶到，宋师大溃，太宗连夜退走，与主力失散。《宋史》对这场败写得含糊，《辽史·景宗纪》把追击写得更明白。本场以辽史能对上的结果为准：南京城北的河岸，宋军向南溃退。

sources.title: 辽史

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画北宋「高梁河」（宋辽首次大战）。时间979 年，宋太平兴国四年 · 辽乾亨元年。地点与格局：高梁河、南京。人物：宋太宗（宋帝）、耶律休哥（辽将）、耶律沙（辽将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "高梁河" in the Northern Song. Place and layout: Gaoliang River, near Yanjing.  Figures: Emperor Taizong of Song, Yelü Xiuge, Yelü Sha. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

negative.zh: 全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀）。不出现任何现代元素：现代建筑、电线、电线杆、公路、车辆、玻璃、塑料、现代服饰、眼镜、手表、枪械、电灯、招牌或文字标识。不出现时代错置之物：西式王冠、尖刺王冠、欧式王冠、礼帽、羽毛头饰、印第安羽冠、尖顶兜帽长袍、三K党兜帽、日本鸟居、日式建筑、武士刀、高速公路、柏油路、车道线、登山杖、双肩背包、徒步者、喷气式飞机、飞机、导弹、台灯、灯罩、灯泡、玻璃灯罩、玻璃窗、玻璃马车、欧式驿马车、美式篷车、招牌、带字匾额、旗上徽记、圆形徽章、标志、藏青色天空、蓝色调、青色、黄色、橙色、西洋大帆船、方帆船、蒸汽船、格子桅杆、烟囱、铁甲舰
negative.en: full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana. no modern elements: no modern buildings, power lines, poles, roads, vehicles, glass, plastic, modern clothing, eyeglasses, watches, guns, electric lights, signs or lettering. no anachronisms: western crown, spiked crown, european crown, top hat, feather headdress, native american headdress, hooded robes, pointed hood, klan hood, torii, japanese architecture, katana, highway, asphalt road, lane markings, trekking poles, backpack, hikers, jet, aircraft, missile, table lamp, lampshade, light bulb, glass lamp chimney, glass windows, glazed carriage, stagecoach, conestoga covered wagon, signboard, plaque with characters, emblem on flag, circular emblem, logo, navy blue sky, blue tint, cyan, yellow, orange, galleon, square-sailed ship, steamship, lattice mast, funnel, ironclad

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是北宋「高梁河」（宋辽首次大战），地点高梁河、南京，人物剪影：宋太宗（宋帝）、耶律休哥（辽将）、耶律沙（辽将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "高梁河" in the Northern Song, at Gaoliang River, near Yanjing. Silhouettes: Emperor Taizong of Song, Yelü Xiuge, Yelü Sha. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：北宋「高梁河」（宋辽首次大战），宋太宗（宋帝）、耶律休哥（辽将）、耶律沙（辽将），高梁河、南京。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "高梁河" in the Northern Song, Emperor Taizong of Song, Yelü Xiuge, Yelü Sha, Gaoliang River, near Yanjing. One rise and fall, then rest.

sound.en: Sound follows the field: wind in banners, distant hooves, armour plates touching, crows, wind on the rampart. No gunfire, no explosions, no modern vehicles. Place for this cue: Gaoliang River, near Yanjing.

scenes.title: 定川寨
scenes.subtitle: 庆历西夏

when.era: 宋庆历二年 · 夏天授礼法延祚五年

scenes.narrative: 好水川的第二年，李元昊再次入宋边。宋将葛怀敏在定川寨被夏军包围，夜里溃围，本人死在乱军里。夏军进到渭州，在城下大掠后退走。范仲淹、韩琦在西北的防守并没有因为一次败仗就撤掉，但定川说明宋军出寨会战仍然容易被引进伏地。本场和好水川分开：换了主将、换了寨名，仍是同一条边境上的第二次大败。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画北宋「定川寨」（庆历西夏）。时间1042 年，宋庆历二年 · 夏天授礼法延祚五年。地点与格局：定川寨、渭州。人物：李元昊（夏国主）、葛怀敏（宋将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "定川寨" in the Northern Song. Place and layout: Dingchuan Fort.  Figures: Li Yuanhao, Ge Huaimin. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画北宋「定川寨」（庆历西夏）。时间1042 年，宋庆历二年 · 夏天授礼法延祚五年。地点与格局：定川寨、渭州。人物：李元昊（夏国主）、葛怀敏（宋将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "定川寨" in the Northern Song. Place and layout: Dingchuan Fort.  Figures: Li Yuanhao, Ge Huaimin. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是北宋「定川寨」（庆历西夏），地点定川寨、渭州，人物剪影：李元昊（夏国主）、葛怀敏（宋将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "定川寨" in the Northern Song, at Dingchuan Fort. Silhouettes: Li Yuanhao, Ge Huaimin. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 陈家岛
scenes.subtitle: 李宝焚舟

when.era: 宋绍兴三十一年 · 金大定元年

scenes.narrative: 海陵王南侵时，金朝水军从密州一带南下。李宝率宋朝舟师北上，在胶西陈家岛附近发现金船还挂着帆、士兵多不习水。宋军趁风放火，金舟大半被烧，赴海的人很多。这一仗和虞允文的采石几乎同时，一个在黄海之滨，一个在长江。本场只取陈家岛的船队和火，不把采石的陆军混进来，也不画近代舰船。

figures.name: 李宝
figures.role: 宋浙西路马步军副总管

sources.title: 宋史
sources.notes: 绍兴三十一年陈家岛焚金舟

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「陈家岛」（李宝焚舟）。时间1161 年，宋绍兴三十一年 · 金大定元年。地点与格局：陈家岛、胶西。人物：李宝（宋浙西路马步军副总管）、完颜郑家（金水军统领）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "陈家岛" in the Southern Song. Place and layout: Chenjia Island.  Figures: Li Bao, Wanyan Zhengjia. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是南宋「陈家岛」（李宝焚舟），地点陈家岛、胶西，人物剪影：李宝（宋浙西路马步军副总管）、完颜郑家（金水军统领）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "陈家岛" in the Southern Song, at Chenjia Island. Silhouettes: Li Bao, Wanyan Zhengjia. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南宋「陈家岛」（李宝焚舟）。时间1161 年，宋绍兴三十一年 · 金大定元年。地点与格局：陈家岛、胶西。人物：李宝（宋浙西路马步军副总管）、完颜郑家（金水军统领）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "陈家岛" in the Southern Song. Place and layout: Chenjia Island.  Figures: Li Bao, Wanyan Zhengjia. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 野狐岭
scenes.subtitle: 蒙古破金

when.era: 金大安三年 · 宋嘉定四年

scenes.narrative: 成吉思汗在大安三年大举攻金。金军在野狐岭、会河川设防，成吉思汗派木华黎率敢死之士冲击，金军大败，死者被史书写成蔽野。野狐岭是从草原进入华北平原的山口，这一仗之后金朝的北边门户等于被打开，中都开始暴露。西夏、南宋的年号此时并存，本场的纪年以金朝大安三年为准，因为防守的一方是金。

sources.title: 元史
sources.notes: 大安三年破金军于野狐岭

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「野狐岭」（蒙古破金）。时间1211 年，金大安三年 · 宋嘉定四年。地点与格局：野狐岭、会河川。人物：成吉思汗（蒙古大汗）、木华黎（蒙古将）、独吉思忠（金将）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "野狐岭" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin. Place and layout: Yehuling Pass.  Figures: Genghis Khan, Muqali, Duji Sizhong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "野狐岭" in the Liao, Western Xia and Jin, at Yehuling Pass. Silhouettes: Genghis Khan, Muqali, Duji Sizhong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 丁家洲
scenes.subtitle: 伯颜渡江

when.era: 元至元十二年 · 宋德祐元年

scenes.narrative: 襄阳、樊城陷落后，伯颜沿汉水入江。贾似道被迫督师，在池州下游的丁家洲把舟师排开。元军炮击并冲阵，宋军没怎么接战就溃了，贾似道逃到扬州。长江上的这次崩溃比崖山早四年，它决定的是沿江州郡不再有统一的防线。本场画江面的船阵和岸上扔下的旗，不把崖山的末帝船队提前画出来。

sources.title: 元史
sources.notes: 至元十二年丁家洲破宋师

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画元「丁家洲」（伯颜渡江）。时间1275 年，元至元十二年 · 宋德祐元年。地点与格局：丁家洲、池州。人物：伯颜（元丞相）、贾似道（宋右丞相）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "丁家洲" in the Yuan. Place and layout: Dingjiazhou.  Figures: Bayan, Jia Sidao. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画元「丁家洲」（伯颜渡江）。时间1275 年，元至元十二年 · 宋德祐元年。地点与格局：丁家洲、池州。人物：伯颜（元丞相）、贾似道（宋右丞相）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "丁家洲" in the Yuan. Place and layout: Dingjiazhou.  Figures: Bayan, Jia Sidao. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

This shot is "丁家洲" in the Yuan, at Dingjiazhou. Silhouettes: Bayan, Jia Sidao. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 白沟河
scenes.subtitle: 靖难前哨
scenes.narrative: 建文二年，李景隆率号称百万的南军北上，与燕王朱棣在白沟河相遇。南军在数量上占优，燕军一度被压到绝境，朱棣几乎陷在阵里。风向一转，南军大火烧营，李景隆连夜逃回德州。这一仗不是金川门那场不战而降，而是靖难里少有的大规模野战。本场只取白沟河的夜火和两军旗帜，不把后来的“诛十族”写进同一画面。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「白沟河」（靖难前哨）。时间1400 年，明建文二年。地点与格局：白沟河。人物：朱棣（燕王）、李景隆（大将军）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "白沟河" in the Ming. Place and layout: Baigou River.  Figures: Zhu Di, Li Jinglong. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。这一场是明「白沟河」（靖难前哨），地点白沟河，人物剪影：朱棣（燕王）、李景隆（大将军）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "白沟河" in the Ming, at Baigou River. Silhouettes: Zhu Di, Li Jinglong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：明「白沟河」（靖难前哨），朱棣（燕王）、李景隆（大将军），白沟河。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "白沟河" in the Ming, Zhu Di, Li Jinglong, Baigou River. One rise and fall, then rest.

Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "白沟河" in the Ming. Place and layout: Baigou River.  Figures: Zhu Di, Li Jinglong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 平壤之战
scenes.subtitle: 李如松援朝
scenes.narrative: 万历朝鲜之役里，日军占领平壤。万历二十一年正月，李如松督明军攻城，用大炮轰开城门一带，日军退向汉城。明军入城后抢掠，李如松斩了自己的部下压住。这是明军在朝鲜打的一次真正的攻城，和后来碧蹄馆的受挫不是同一天。本场画冬日的平壤城墙和城门上的烟，画面里不出现近代枪械的特写，火器只作为城头的烟。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「平壤之战」（李如松援朝）。时间1593 年，明万历二十一年。地点与格局：平壤。人物：李如松（明提督）、小西行长（日军将领）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "平壤之战" in the Ming. Place and layout: Pyongyang.  Figures: Li Rusong, Konishi Yukinaga. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画明「平壤之战」（李如松援朝）。时间1593 年，明万历二十一年。地点与格局：平壤。人物：李如松（明提督）、小西行长（日军将领）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "平壤之战" in the Ming. Place and layout: Pyongyang.  Figures: Li Rusong, Konishi Yukinaga. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 松锦之战
scenes.subtitle: 洪承畴

when.era: 明崇祯十三年至十五年
when.notes: start 取围城之始；城破与洪承畴降在崇祯十五年。

scenes.narrative: 清军围锦州，明廷派洪承畴出山海关救援。他起初主守，朝里催促进战，明军集结在松山。皇太极切断粮道之后，明军夜溃，洪承畴被困在松山，次年城破被俘，祖大寿也开锦州出降。松锦之后，明朝在关外只剩下宁远等少数孤城。本场和袁崇焕的宁远守城分开：那是天启的胜仗，这是崇祯的大败。画面取长围、粮道和关外的雪。

sources.title: 明史
sources.notes: 崇祯十五年松山陷，洪承畴降

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「松锦之战」（洪承畴）。时间1640—1642 年，明崇祯十三年至十五年。地点与格局：松山、锦州。人物：洪承畴（明蓟辽总督）、皇太极（清太宗）、祖大寿（明总兵）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "松锦之战" in the Ming. Place and layout: Songshan and Jinzhou.  Figures: Hong Chengchou, Hong Taiji, Zu Dashou. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. This shot is "松锦之战" in the Ming, at Songshan and Jinzhou. Silhouettes: Hong Chengchou, Hong Taiji, Zu Dashou. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画明「松锦之战」（洪承畴）。时间1640—1642 年，明崇祯十三年至十五年。地点与格局：松山、锦州。人物：洪承畴（明蓟辽总督）、皇太极（清太宗）、祖大寿（明总兵）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "松锦之战" in the Ming. Place and layout: Songshan and Jinzhou.  Figures: Hong Chengchou, Hong Taiji, Zu Dashou. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 雅克萨
scenes.subtitle: 两次围城

when.era: 清康熙二十四年至二十五年
when.notes: 康熙二十四年取城，二十五年俄军复至，再次围城后议和。

scenes.narrative: 俄罗斯人在雅克萨筑城，清廷先致书，不成，康熙二十四年派彭春、萨布素等水陆并进，攻下城后平毁，允许俄人退走。第二年俄军又回来筑城，清军再围。双方最后在尼布楚谈界。本场只写这两次围城，不把康熙二十八年的条约文本放进画面——划界已有专场可走。画面是黑龙江上的木城、船只和城外的营垒。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 康熙二十四年攻雅克萨，二十五年复围

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画清「雅克萨」（两次围城）。时间1685—1686 年，清康熙二十四年至二十五年。地点与格局：雅克萨、黑龙江。人物：萨布素（清黑龙江将军）、彭春（清都统）、托尔布津（俄军头目）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "雅克萨" in the Qing. Place and layout: Albazin on the Amur.  Figures: Sabsu, Pengcun, Afanasy Tolbuzin. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是清「雅克萨」（两次围城），地点雅克萨、黑龙江，人物剪影：萨布素（清黑龙江将军）、彭春（清都统）、托尔布津（俄军头目）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "雅克萨" in the Qing, at Albazin on the Amur. Silhouettes: Sabsu, Pengcun, Afanasy Tolbuzin. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 昭莫多
scenes.subtitle: 费扬古
scenes.narrative: 康熙亲征噶尔丹，自己率中路出草原，西路费扬古拦在昭莫多。噶尔丹的军队从土拉河来，费扬古先据山，用下马步战拖住，再以骑兵袭其后营。噶尔丹丢掉辎重逃走，阿奴等人战死。昭莫多是乌兰布通之后真正把噶尔丹从漠北打散的一仗。本场画山梁上的下马军阵和河湾，康熙的御营放在远处，不画近代地图的经纬线。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 康熙三十五年昭莫多之战

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画清「昭莫多」（费扬古）。时间1696 年，清康熙三十五年。地点与格局：昭莫多、土拉河。人物：费扬古（清抚远大将军）、噶尔丹（准噶尔汗）、康熙帝（清帝）。武人剪影只留冠帽、兵器与甲片的大轮廓；文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲。头身比约 1:7，无五官，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "昭莫多" in the Qing. Place and layout: Zuunmod and the Tuul.  Figures: Fiyanggū, Galdan, Kangxi Emperor. soldiers keep only the big shapes of headgear, weapon and armour; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour. About 7 heads tall, no facial features, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画清「昭莫多」（费扬古）。时间1696 年，清康熙三十五年。地点与格局：昭莫多、土拉河。人物：费扬古（清抚远大将军）、噶尔丹（准噶尔汗）、康熙帝（清帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "昭莫多" in the Qing. Place and layout: Zuunmod and the Tuul.  Figures: Fiyanggū, Galdan, Kangxi Emperor. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是清「昭莫多」（费扬古），地点昭莫多、土拉河，人物剪影：费扬古（清抚远大将军）、噶尔丹（准噶尔汗）、康熙帝（清帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "昭莫多" in the Qing, at Zuunmod and the Tuul. Silhouettes: Fiyanggū, Galdan, Kangxi Emperor. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 尽地力
scenes.subtitle: 李悝

when.notes: 李悝为魏文侯作法经、尽地力，年份只能取文侯中期。

scenes.narrative: 魏文侯用李悝。汉代人追述他说李悝作尽地力之教，鼓励农耕，又以平籴在丰年收购、荒年抛出，还编过《法经》六篇。这些话主要保存在《汉书·食货志》和《晋书·刑法志》，不是魏国当时的原档。能采纳的是：战国变法不是从商鞅才开始，魏国更早把土地和刑律当成国家工程。本场画井田式的墨线和一册刑书，并注明法经原文已佚。

sources.title: 汉书
sources.notes: 李悝为魏文侯作尽地力之教

sources.title: 晋书
sources.notes: 李悝撰法经六篇，书已佚

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画战国「尽地力」（李悝）。时间约前 400 年，魏文侯时（年号未行）。地点与格局：魏。人物：李悝（魏臣）、魏文侯（魏君）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "尽地力" in the Warring States. Place and layout: Wei.  Figures: Li Kui, Marquis Wen of Wei. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. scenes.title: 屯田奏
scenes.subtitle: 赵充国
scenes.narrative: 神爵元年，西羌反。赵充国在金城主张罢骑兵、留步兵在湟中屯田，上了三份奏，反复和朝里主战的人争。宣帝最终允许他留兵开垦，羌人后来分化。《汉书·赵充国传》把奏文保存得很完整，是西汉少见的、把军费算成粮食账的文件。本场画湟水边的营田和奏牍，不画陈汤那种千里突袭。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「屯田奏」（赵充国）。时间前 60 年，汉宣帝神爵元年。地点与格局：湟中、金城。人物：赵充国（后将军）、汉宣帝（汉帝）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "屯田奏" in the Western Han. Place and layout: Huangzhong.  Figures: Zhao Chongguo, Emperor Xuan of Han. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. This shot is "屯田奏" in the Western Han, at Huangzhong. Silhouettes: Zhao Chongguo, Emperor Xuan of Han. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画楚汉 · 西汉「屯田奏」（赵充国）。时间前 60 年，汉宣帝神爵元年。地点与格局：湟中、金城。人物：赵充国（后将军）、汉宣帝（汉帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "屯田奏" in the Western Han. Place and layout: Huangzhong.  Figures: Zhao Chongguo, Emperor Xuan of Han. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是楚汉 · 西汉「屯田奏」（赵充国），地点湟中、金城，人物剪影：赵充国（后将军）、汉宣帝（汉帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "屯田奏" in the Western Han, at Huangzhong. Silhouettes: Zhao Chongguo, Emperor Xuan of Han. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "屯田奏" in the Western Han, Zhao Chongguo, Emperor Xuan of Han, Huangzhong. One rise and fall, then rest.

scenes.title: 许下屯田
scenes.subtitle: 枣祗
scenes.narrative: 建安元年曹操迎献帝到许，同时采纳枣祗、韩浩的办法，在许下屯田，用官牛收租。一年得谷百万斛，后来推广到各州郡。《三国志·武帝纪》和《任峻传》都把这件事写成曹氏能支撑长期战争的原因。它是治国，不是官渡的夜袭：先有粮，才有后来的仗。本场画许县郊外的屯田和粮堆，不画官渡的火。

sources.title: 三国志
sources.notes: 建安元年用枣祗、韩浩等议，始兴屯田

sources.title: 三国志
sources.notes: 军国之饶，起于枣祗而成于峻

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画三国「许下屯田」（枣祗）。时间196 年，汉建安元年。地点与格局：许。人物：曹操（汉司空）、枣祗（屯田都尉）、任峻（典农中郎将）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "许下屯田" in the Three Kingdoms. Place and layout: Xu.  Figures: Cao Cao, Zao Zhi, Ren Jun. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍朝会里衣袖轻动、地图上的墨线缓缓延伸、仓廪与渠水几乎静止，镜头缓推后定格。这一场是三国「许下屯田」（枣祗），地点许，人物剪影：曹操（汉司空）、枣祗（屯田都尉）、任峻（典农中郎将）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. This shot is "许下屯田" in the Three Kingdoms, at Xu. Silhouettes: Cao Cao, Zao Zhi, Ren Jun. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.
