image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画三国「许下屯田」（枣祗）。时间196 年，汉建安元年。地点与格局：许。人物：曹操（汉司空）、枣祗（屯田都尉）、任峻（典农中郎将）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "许下屯田" in the Three Kingdoms. Place and layout: Xu.  Figures: Cao Cao, Zao Zhi, Ren Jun. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 均田令
scenes.subtitle: 太和九年
scenes.narrative: 太和九年，北魏下诏均田：十五岁以上的男夫受露田四十亩，妇人二十亩，奴婢依良人，另有桑田。土地在年老或身死后还官，桑田可以留。《魏书·食货志》记录了这个框架。它是鲜卑政权在中原用汉地的亩制重新把劳动力绑到土地上。和太和十年的三长制是一套改革的两步，本场只写授田的文书，三长另场。

sources.title: 魏书
sources.notes: 太和九年十月丁未，诏均给天下民田

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画南北朝「均田令」（太和九年）。时间485 年，北魏太和九年。地点与格局：平城。人物：冯太后（临朝称制）、北魏孝文帝（魏帝）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "均田令" in the Northern and Southern dynasties. Place and layout: Pingcheng.  Figures: Empress Dowager Feng, Emperor Xiaowen. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍朝会里衣袖轻动、地图上的墨线缓缓延伸、仓廪与渠水几乎静止，镜头缓推后定格。这一场是南北朝「均田令」（太和九年），地点平城，人物剪影：冯太后（临朝称制）、北魏孝文帝（魏帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. This shot is "均田令" in the Northern and Southern dynasties, at Pingcheng. Silhouettes: Empress Dowager Feng, Emperor Xiaowen. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 经界法
scenes.subtitle: 李椿年
scenes.narrative: 和议刚签，李椿年请在平江开始经界：丈量田亩，造砧基簿，让产有主、税有地。绍兴十二年推行，后来扩到其他路，也因为扰民和豪强抵制时停时续。《宋史·食货志》记录了砧基簿的办法。这是南宋在半壁江山上重做土地账。本场画田埂、图帐和拒测的村庄，不画前线。

sources.title: 宋史
sources.notes: 绍兴十二年李椿年经界，造砧基簿

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画南宋「经界法」（李椿年）。时间1142 年，宋绍兴十二年。地点与格局：平江。人物：李椿年（两浙转运副使）、宋高宗（宋帝）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "经界法" in the Southern Song. Place and layout: Pingjiang.  Figures: Li Chunnian, Emperor Gaozong. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画南宋「经界法」（李椿年）。时间1142 年，宋绍兴十二年。地点与格局：平江。人物：李椿年（两浙转运副使）、宋高宗（宋帝）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "经界法" in the Southern Song. Place and layout: Pingjiang.  Figures: Li Chunnian, Emperor Gaozong. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是南宋「经界法」（李椿年），地点平江，人物剪影：李椿年（两浙转运副使）、宋高宗（宋帝）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "经界法" in the Southern Song, at Pingjiang. Silhouettes: Li Chunnian, Emperor Gaozong. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 行省
scenes.subtitle: 政令出中书

when.era: 元世祖至元十七年前后
when.notes: 行省从出征时的行中书省逐渐变成固定大区，年份取至元中叶，不假装有一天颁定全国。

scenes.narrative: 蒙古出征时派行中书省随军。忽必烈定都之后，这些行省慢慢变成固定的大行政区，掌一路的钱粮、兵甲和刑名，上面是中书省。《元史·百官志》记录了各行省的名称和职掌。这是中国地方制度里“省”的直接来源。本场画从大都伸向各路的墨线，不把行省当成清代的总督衙门。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画元「行省」（政令出中书）。时间约至元中，元世祖至元十七年前后。地点与格局：大都。人物：忽必烈（元世祖）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "行省" in the Yuan. Place and layout: Dadu.  Figures: Kublai Khan. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频只拍朝会里衣袖轻动、地图上的墨线缓缓延伸、仓廪与渠水几乎静止，镜头缓推后定格。这一场是元「行省」（政令出中书），地点大都，人物剪影：忽必烈（元世祖）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. This shot is "行省" in the Yuan, at Dadu. Silhouettes: Kublai Khan. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

music.en: Music is solemn and courtly: bells and qin, slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no battlefield drums. This cue: "行省" in the Yuan, Kublai Khan, Dadu. One rise and fall, then rest.

scenes.title: 鱼鳞图册
scenes.subtitle: 洪武二十年
scenes.narrative: 洪武二十年，明朝在各地攒造鱼鳞图册，把每块田的形状、四至、业主画成相连的鱼鳞状图，和赋役黄册互相核对。《明史·食货志》说明黄册管户、鱼鳞图册管田。这是朱元璋在全国范围内重做土地底账。本场画一册打开的田图，不画胡惟庸案的朝堂——那是洪武十三年的另一场政治清洗。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画明「鱼鳞图册」（洪武二十年）。时间1387 年，明洪武二十年。地点与格局：南京。人物：朱元璋（明太祖）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "鱼鳞图册" in the Ming. Place and layout: Nanjing.  Figures: Zhu Yuanzhang. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. This shot is "鱼鳞图册" in the Ming, at Nanjing. Silhouettes: Zhu Yuanzhang. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画明「鱼鳞图册」（洪武二十年）。时间1387 年，明洪武二十年。地点与格局：南京。人物：朱元璋（明太祖）。人物只作为路线上的小剪影，不画五官，不占满画面。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "鱼鳞图册" in the Ming. Place and layout: Nanjing.  Figures: Zhu Yuanzhang. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。这一场是明「鱼鳞图册」（洪武二十年），地点南京，人物剪影：朱元璋（明太祖）。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。画面内不写字。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. This shot is "鱼鳞图册" in the Ming, at Nanjing. Silhouettes: Zhu Yuanzhang. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 海禁
scenes.subtitle: 寸板不许下海

when.notes: 禁海诏令的年月各书详略不同，本场只取洪武初禁止私自出海这一政策，不锁定某一道诏的日子。

scenes.narrative: 洪武年间明朝禁止民间私造海船、私自下海通番，朝贡以外的海上贸易被当成犯罪。《明史·食货志》把海禁和后来的倭乱、市舶废置连在一起叙述。郑和的船队是朝贡体系里的例外，不是这道禁令的取消。本场画封住的海口和空着的市舶公案。具体哪一天第一道诏书发出，材料不一致，所以年份用约数。

sources.title: 明史
sources.notes: 洪武禁濒海民私通海外

sources.title: 明史
sources.notes: 海禁之严，至寸板不许下海，系后世概括

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画明「海禁」（寸板不许下海）。时间约洪武初，明洪武五年前后。地点与格局：沿海卫所。人物：朱元璋（明太祖）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "海禁" in the Ming. Place and layout: the coastal guards.  Figures: Zhu Yuanzhang. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Image-to-video shows sleeves stirring in court, an ink line slowly extending across a map of reforms, granaries and canal water nearly still, then a slow push into a freeze-frame. This shot is "海禁" in the Ming, at the coastal guards. Silhouettes: Zhu Yuanzhang. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only. No text in the frame.

image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "海禁" in the Ming. Place and layout: the coastal guards.  Figures: Zhu Yuanzhang. figures are only small silhouettes on the route, no facial features, not filling the frame. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 改土归流
scenes.subtitle: 鄂尔泰
scenes.narrative: 西南土司世袭管地、管人。雍正四年，云贵总督鄂尔泰奏请在用兵能到的地方改设流官，雍正批准，云南、贵州、广西和四川的一部分土司被废。《清史稿·土司传》和《鄂尔泰传》写了推行，也写了乌蒙、古州等地的反抗和清军的镇压。这不是和平的行政更名。本场画土司印信被收走、流官的关防送进山寨，不回避镇压，也不把它画成现代的省界测绘。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画清「改土归流」（鄂尔泰）。时间1726 年，清雍正四年。地点与格局：云南、贵州。人物：鄂尔泰（云贵总督）、雍正帝（清帝）。黑色剪影，文臣与女眷不持兵器、不披甲，只留冠帽、宽袖、笏板或竹简的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，无五官。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "改土归流" in the Qing. Place and layout: Yunnan and Guizhou.  Figures: Ortai, Yongzheng Emperor. black silhouettes; officials and women hold no weapon and wear no armour, only the big shapes of caps, wide sleeves, a tablet or bamboo slips, about 7 heads tall, no facial features. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐开阔：长音如风沿着地图上的河走远，低而慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要紧促的战鼓。本场：清「改土归流」（鄂尔泰），鄂尔泰（云贵总督）、雍正帝（清帝），云南、贵州。只随这一场的转折起伏一次。
music.en: Music is expansive: long tones like wind travelling a river on the map, low and slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no urgent war drums. This cue: "改土归流" in the Qing, Ortai, Yongzheng Emperor, Yunnan and Guizhou. One rise and fall, then rest.

sound.zh: 声响以地形为线：水声、风过关隘、城门、路上的脚步、远鸦。不要室内朝会的闷响。本场地点：云南、贵州。
sound.en: Sound follows the terrain: water, wind in a pass, a city gate, footsteps on a road, a distant crow. No muffled court interior. Place for this cue: Yunnan and Guizhou.
